title: Data Analyst Consultant (m/w/d) - Quereinsteiger willkommen! DSDE 14 - 01. März 2027
description: Application Deadline: 24th November 2026 Du möchtest etwas bewegen und hast Lust darauf, Teil eines Teams zu sein, das anderen Menschen hilft, Daten zu verstehen und aus ihnen Nutzen zu ziehen? Dann bist du bei The Information Lab genau richtig! Unsere Mission ist einfach: Wir möchten Menschen dabei unterstützen, Daten zu verstehen. Wir sind der Meinung, dass Unternehmen, die Daten sinnvoll einsetzen, bessere Zukunftsaussichten haben als andere und haben bereits Kunden wie PwC, Rheinenergie, Johnson & Johnson, Fielmann, Volkswagen und DZ Bank dabei geholfen, Datenvisualisierung und Datenintegration mit den führenden Produkten Tableau und Alteryx zu optimieren. Als Consultant in The Data School bekommst du weit mehr als nur eine durchschnittliche Ausbildung. Du erhältst ein Gehalt, um dich von einigen der besten Datenexperten weltweit (darunter 6 Tableau Visionaries und zwei Alteryx ACEs ) über Daten und Technologie weiterbilden zu lassen. Innerhalb von 4 Monaten erhältst du eine intensive und umfangreiche Ausbildung in unserer fantastischen Data School im Zentrum von Hamburg. Und das Beste daran? Du hast die Chance, dein neues Wissen und deine Fähigkeiten bei einigen der größten und bekanntesten Global Playern und beim Deutschen Mittelstand in Deutschland, Österreich, der Schweiz und Großbritannien unter Beweis zu stellen. Wir vermitteln nicht nur Technologie um ihrer selbst willen. Und wir unterrichten nicht auf irgendeine beliebige Art und Weise. Mit Unterstützung deiner Coaches und des gesamten Teams lernst du nicht nur, wie man Daten speichert, verwaltet und präsentiert, sondern auch persönliche Fähigkeiten, um dein Selbstvertrauen zu stärken und zu einem außergewöhnlichen Berater zu werden. Und all das in einer Umgebung, die außergewöhnlich inklusiv und kooperativ ist. Du hast noch nie von Tableau oder Alteryx gehört? Kein Problem. Unsere Consultants haben verschiedene Hintergründe und viele von ihnen hatten noch nie von Tableau gehört, bevor sie auf uns gestoßen sind. Hier kannst du einige von ihnen kennenlernen. Was sie alle gemeinsam haben, ist jedoch ihre Leidenschaft für Problemlösung, insbesondere für Problemlösung mit Daten und Fakten. Wenn du also dieselbe neugierige Natur teilst und eine Leidenschaft dafür hast, durch Daten die Wahrheit zu finden, dann könnte The Data School der perfekte Start oder das nächste Kapitel deiner Karriere sein. Bei The Information Lab und The Data School ist jeder willkommen, unabhängig von seiner Herkunft, seiner Studiengeschichte, seinem Aussehen oder den Themen, die er in seiner Freizeit analysiert. Je mehr Vielfalt wir bei der Analyse von Daten unserer Kunden und des Rests der Welt haben, desto vielfältiger sind unsere Erkenntnisse und desto besser sind die Verbesserungen, die wir erzielen können. Wir suchen nach Leidenschaft für das Thema... zeig uns deine! Eine Anleitung und Hilfestellung zu unserem Bewerbungsprozess findest du hier . Schau dir auch gern die Bewerbunsgdashboards an, die in der Vergangenheit erfolgreich waren. Wenn du dich vorab auf das Thema Datenanalyse vorbereiten möchtest, ist unser Youtube Channel eine großartige Ressource, denn hier bieten wir dir regelmäßig Lerninhalte für Tableau. Solltest du Fragen haben, melde dich gerne per E-Mail über [email protected] bei uns. Wir würden uns freuen, von dir zu hören, wenn du: gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse besitzt (beides mindestens B2) numerisch veranlagt bist analytisch denkst datengetrieben bist gut im Umgang mit Menschen bist Problemlöser/in bist selbstbewusst kommunizieren kannst Fakten und Zahlen Standort: Kaiser-Wilhelm-Straße 93, 20355 Hamburg Vertrag: 29 Monate befristet Gehalt: 39.000€ brutto p.a., Gehaltserhöhung nach 17 Monaten auf 44.000€ brutto p.a. Urlaub: 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub Unterstützung bei Umzug nach Hamburg für Aufnahme der Tätigkeit: Du kannst bis zu 500€ erstattet bekommen Weitere Vorteile: regelmäßige Team Events, Bezuschussung von betrieblicher Altersvorsorge, Ausbau deines beruflichen Netzwerks Wir stellen alle 4 Monate bis zu 8 Personen ein und bieten ihnen die Möglichkeit, einen bestimmten Einstiegstermin anzugeben. Erfolgreiche Bewerbende erhalten einen 29 monatigen befristeten Vertrag bei The Information Lab mit einem Startgehalt von 39.000€ pro Jahr, das im Laufe des Programms steigt. Leider können wir nur Bewerbende für diese Stelle akzeptieren, die ein Recht auf Arbeit in Deutschland haben, sicher auf Deutsch (min. B2) und Englisch (B2) kommunizieren können und die wohnhaft in Deutschland leben. Wir rekrutieren aus allen Studiengängen und akademischen Hintergründen und begrüßen Bewerbungen von Quereinsteigenden. Wir sind stolz auf unsere vielfältige Arbeitsumgebung und diskriminieren nicht aufgrund von Geschlecht, Ethnizität, Rasse oder sexueller Orientierung. Wenn du Fragen hast, kontaktiere uns bitte per E-Mail unter [email protected] .

title: Consultant
description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. Location This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with occasional visits to customers across the DACH region. As team collaboration is of great importance to us, we highly encourage team members to join us in Zurich at least once a month. These visits are financially supported by BLP. About the role For a process to run autonomously, four things have to line up: the technology, the process itself, the data behind it, and the people who work with it. That alignment does not happen at go-live. It happens in the months after, and that is where this role sits. Our customers go live with a working solution. What they do not have on day one is an organisation that operates in an AI-native way. Processes were designed around people checking things. Data was maintained well enough for humans to interpret. Teams know the old workarounds better than the new system. Your job is to lead that transition, from a process that is automated in parts to a process that genuinely runs on its own. That means working across every level of the customer's organisation. With operational teams you build understanding and find where automation is actually blocked. With department leads you challenge the process rules that make full automation impossible, and drive the decisions that change them. And you use the right lever for each blocker, because they are all different: some are a data clean-up you coordinate with the customer, some are a training and adoption gap, some need a custom agent, and some are structural and belong with our engineering teams. You do not do this alone. You enable the customer's core team to solve their own issues, you work with our Customer Success Engineers on the technical side, and you use the Customer Success Manager to get decisions made where you need commercial weight. For our smaller customers, where there is no Customer Success Manager, you are the escalation point yourself. You own customer health. Your sharpest measure of it is the automation rate. What you'll do Own customer health across your portfolio, measured first and foremost by automation rates. Lead the transition to AI-native ways of working: identify what blocks automation, and pick the right way to solve each blocker. Work with operational teams on enablement and adoption, so people work efficiently with blp rather than around it. Challenge process rules that prevent automation, and drive improvements with the department leads who can decide. Coordinate data clean-up with the customer where master data quality is capping what automation can reach. Enable the customer's core team to resolve issues themselves, and reduce what has to come to us at all. Identify where a custom agent solves the problem, and where the issue is structural and belongs with our engineering teams. Collaborate with Customer Success Engineers on technical topics, and with the Customer Success Manager to get decisions made. For customers without a Customer Success Manager, act as the escalation point for SLA breaches and own continuity of operations. Direct the AI Automation Specialists working on your accounts. What we're really looking for The following key attributes ensure success in this role: Process Excellence – You understand core business processes deeply, P2P and O2C, and you can see why a process is shaped the way it is and what it could look like instead. Client Hands – You bring customers with you. You are strict on the things that matter and flexible on the things that do not, you understand the context people are working in, and you have more than one way of convincing them. Ownership & Autonomy – You take a customer from live to high automation without being told the steps. Comfort in the Data – You go into the numbers yourself to find where automation is leaking. Problem Solving & Critical Thinking – You separate a configuration symptom from a process cause, and pick the right lever for each. What you'll bring Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 3+ years of experience in consulting, process improvement, shared services, or ERP process ownership. Deep working knowledge of at least one core business process end to end, purchase-to-pay or order-to-cash. This is a prerequisite, not a nice to have. Demonstrable experience changing how a finance, procurement or supply chain team actually works, not only advising on it. Strong analytical skills. You are comfortable working with process and transaction data directly. Confident facilitating workshops with operational teams and presenting to their leadership. Fluent in German and English, spoken and written. Bonus points for experience with ERP systems, accounts payable or order management processes, or AI-driven SaaS. What you'll get High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path. Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises. Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily. Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression. Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option programme. Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators. Technology exposure – be at the forefront of emerging technologies and enjoy continuous learning opportunities. Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites. Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact. Learn more about blp and our values at https://blp.digital/company/careers .

title: Senior Customer Success Engineer
description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. Location This is a full-time position based at our HQ in Munich or Cologne. About the role You solve the hard technical problems on live systems. Once a customer is running on blp, their processes are business critical. Invoices post or they do not. Orders flow or they sit. Our support organisation resolves most of what comes in, and a lot of it is genuinely well handled by people early in their career. What is left is yours: the cases where the cause is not obvious, where it crosses systems, data and process logic at once, where the same symptom has three possible explanations and only one of them is right. That is the job. Not a queue, and not the easy half of one. Everything difficult that comes out of the run phase lands with you. Two things sit alongside the case work, and they are what make this a senior job rather than a harder version of a junior one. Stabilising accounts When an account's health goes bad, you go in and stabilise it. Not as a permanent assignment, but as a small, highly skilled squad that takes a customer whose numbers or whose confidence have slipped, works out what is actually wrong across the whole picture, fixes it, and hands back a customer who is running properly again. It is the most concentrated version of this work there is. Taking effort out permanently Anything that keeps arriving in the queue is a signal, and the answer is usually not more people answering it. It might be better self-service for customers, a customer-facing assistant that resolves the routine questions before they reach us, better diagnostics, or a change in how something is configured at deployment so the problem never occurs. You are expected to find those, make the case, and drive them through. That is how a support organisation scales without scaling headcount one for one, and it is value the customer feels directly. You work across the boundary between what our platform does, what the customer's ERP does, and what their data actually looks like. You are the one who can read a failing case end to end and say what really happened, and then say credibly whether the fix is configuration, data, process, or a genuine product issue. When it is a product issue, you are the counterpart to our engineering and product teams: you bring the evidence, and because you have seen the same structural problem across several customers, your case is the one that moves the roadmap. You are also how this function gets better rather than just bigger. The diagnostic tooling, the patterns, the documentation that lets a first-year person resolve what used to take a senior one: that is yours to build. And the interns and specialists coming through the team learn this craft from you. You do not deliver integrations and you do not run go-lives. Our integrations engineers and technical project managers own that. You own what happens once it is live and it is challenging. What you'll do Own the technically difficult cases from our live customer base, end to end, to a verified root cause. Diagnose across boundaries: platform behaviour, ERP behaviour, master data and process logic. Decide what the real fix is, and make it: configuration, data, process, or a case for engineering. Go into accounts with a deteriorating health score, diagnose across the whole picture, stabilise them and hand them back running properly. Drive strategic initiatives that permanently reduce effort and improve the customer experience, from better diagnostics to customer-facing self-service and assistants. Act as the counterpart to Product and Engineering, with evidence strong enough to change priorities. Recognise structural problems across customers and push for them to be solved once. Build the diagnostic tooling, patterns and documentation that raise what the rest of the team can resolve alone. Mentor interns and earlier-career colleagues, and raise the technical bar of the function. Support Consultants and Customer Success Managers on the technical substance of customer escalations. What we're really looking for The following key attributes ensure success in this role: Root Cause, Not Symptom – You are not finished when it stops happening. You are finished when you know why. Cross-Boundary Reasoning – You hold platform, ERP, data and process in your head at once and find where the truth is. Credible Both Ways – You explain the same problem to an engineer and to a CFO, and both of them believe you. Leverage – Your instinct is to remove the next hundred cases, not only to close this one. You would rather build the thing that makes a problem stop arriving. Calm Under Escalation – When a business-critical process is stopped, you get more precise rather than faster. Stabilizer Under Pressure : An unhappy client is not a fire to put out. It is a relationship to rebuild. You bring the temperature down, put structure back into the account, and align next steps so trust returns, not just silence What you'll bring Master's degree in a STEM field: computer science, engineering, information systems, mathematics, physics or similar. Strong candidates from a related field are welcome to make their case. 3+ years in a technical customer-facing role: application support at depth, technical consulting, solution engineering, integration engineering or equivalent. Demonstrable debugging ability across systems, not only within one. APIs, data mapping, interfaces, logs. Comfortable with data. SQL or equivalent, and the instinct to check rather than assume. German and English, both fluent. This is a hard requirement. Our customers work in German every day and our internal work runs in English. Nice to have: ERP experience with SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or similar, scripting in any language, or exposure to workflow automation and process mining. What you'll get The hard problems, not the queue. Influence on the product, with a direct line to Engineering and Product. Room to shape the function, since the practice is still being built. Real growth – the path from here leads into Consulting, technical leadership within Customer Success, or Product. Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option programme. Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators. Visits & offsites – including collaborative team offsites. Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact. Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers .

title: Customer Success Engineer (Internship)
description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. Location This is a six-month internship based in Munich or Cologne. This is an in-person role. You learn this job by sitting next to people who already do it, and that does not work remotely. About the role Think of this role as the modern Sherlock Holmes — new puzzles to solve and new people to work with, every single day. This role sits exactly at the intersection of technology and business, and that is not a figure of speech. On one side you are in the system, in the data, working out what actually happened. On the other you are on a call with a finance team explaining it and agreeing what to do. You need both, every day. Our customers run their finance and supply chain processes on blp. When something does not behave the way they expected, a document that did not post, an exception that should have resolved itself, a number in a dashboard that looks wrong, they write to us. That is where your work starts, and it is also where you become the face of blp for that customer. What reaches them is you: your answer, your explanation, your judgement about what to do next. You will not be reading from a script and escalating. You investigate what the system did, what the data says and what the customer's process actually requires. You have the access and the authority to change configuration when that is the answer. And when it is not, you know who to bring in and what to give them. The role grows with you. You start on cases where the pattern is known and someone is close by. As your expertise builds you take the harder ones, and your exposure to customers grows with it: from written answers, to calls, to being in the room when a customer wants their most pressing problem solved now. This goes well beyond tickets. We are a fast-moving organisation and a lot of what needs to exist does not exist yet. You will take on and drive initiatives that make the whole operation scale: a recurring problem that should be solved once rather than fifty times, a piece of tooling that does not exist, a way of working that has outgrown itself. Interns here have shipped things that the team still uses. How we think about ownership You will be given real work with real consequences, early, because that is the only way anyone learns this job properly. The other half of that is judgement: explore and decide for yourself where you can, and pull someone in when something critical is on the line. Knowing which situation you are in is part of the skill, and nobody will hold it against you for asking. What matters is that you are the face of blp to that customer, and that you take that seriously. Most of our customers work in German and you will be in front of them from early on. That is uncomfortable for about three weeks and then it is the best part of the job. This is a real internship, not an observation post. You will be trusted with live customers quickly, with people close by while you learn. What you'll do Answer incoming customer requests through our support channel, and be the person they hear back from. Own incidents end to end: investigate, resolve, and confirm with the customer that it is actually fixed. Work out why a workflow, document or posting did not behave as expected. Adjust configuration where that is the right fix. Recognise when a problem is bigger than one case, and hand it on with proper evidence. Join customer calls to work through urgent issues directly, as your experience grows. Take on initiatives beyond the queue: things that should be fixed once rather than answered repeatedly. Document what you learn so the next person does not have to learn it twice. What we're really looking for We do not expect you to know ERP systems. We expect you to be the kind of person who gets to the bottom of things. Curiosity – You want to know why something works, not just that it does. Clear Logic – You take a messy situation apart, find the actual cause, and explain it simply. Customer Nerve – You stay calm and credible with a frustrated controller on the phone, and you can say "I do not know yet, here is how I will find out." Self-Driven – You close your own knowledge gaps without being told to. Ownership – You see things through without someone checking, and you know when to pull someone in. What you'll bring Enrolled in or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's in business, economics, information systems, engineering, computer science, or something adjacent. Strong candidates from other backgrounds are welcome to make their case. German and English, both fluent. This is a hard requirement. Our customers work in German every day and our internal work runs in English. Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with data. Genuine interest in enterprise software, AI, and how large organisations actually run. Nice to have, not required: first exposure to ERP systems, SQL, APIs, or process modelling. Where it leads Our internship is the main entry point into the delivery organisation. Interns who do well are offered a permanent role, most often as a Customer Success Engineer or as an AI Automation Specialist, and from there the paths into Consulting and into project management are well travelled. We tell you early and honestly whether that conversation is coming. What you'll get Real responsibility from week three, not shadowing. A steep learning curve on live enterprise systems. Direct access to engineers, product managers, and the people running our customers' finance operations. Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option programme. Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators. Visits & offsites – including collaborative team offsites. Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact. Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers .

title: Senior Electrical Engineer (Integrations)
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. In Germany, home to the largest electricity market in Europe and a roadmap toward Net Zero by 2045, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid. Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. We are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As we expand our footprint in Germany and the wider European market, we are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to lead our regional technical market-access and integration efforts. 🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and customer growth in Germany, we are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to work with stakeholders to develop our DSR (Demand Side Response) and flexibility pipeline. You will own the regional relationship, the integration approach, and the design that the UK team then implements. Engineering background: Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control, or a related field ( or equivalent practical experience in industrial/energy integration). Integration & connectivity: Proven experience establishing industrial communication and connectivity between field equipment and external systems (telemetry and/or control). Power-plant systems: Working understanding of power-plant control systems and instrumentation, including metering. German market knowledge: TSO/DSO hierarchy and the connection/integration process. Ancillary services (FCR, aFRR, mFRR) prequalification and technical requirements. Redispatch 3.0 regulatory framework. Customer-facing delivery: Ability to produce technical integration approaches and communicate them to customers, regulators, and internal teams. Travel: Occasional travel may be required. Understanding of IT/OT security in the energy sector ( NIS2, EnWG/KRITIS awareness ; IEC 62443 a plus). Familiarity with software languages, version-controlled configuration, and general tooling. Exposure to the wider European balancing markets / ENTSO-E frameworks beyond Germany. title: Fractional Finance Manager

Build customer-facing features across our marketplace, campaign management, collaboration, payments, analytics, and creator workflows. Help make Zest an indispensable part of how modern companies run creator-led growth. Turn foundation models into structured, reliable product experiences—not just impressive prototypes. Work on intelligent workflows involving agents, tools, retrieval, search, recommendations, and generated interfaces. Develop the evaluations, observability, and feedback loops needed to understand whether AI features are genuinely useful. Work closely with design to create experiences that are fast, intuitive, and polished. Talk directly with customers and translate ambiguous needs into simple product decisions. Make pragmatic architectural choices that balance speed, quality, maintainability, and performance. Improve the systems and engineering practices that help a small team ship reliably at high velocity. At Staff level, provide technical direction across projects, raise the engineering bar, and help other engineers make better decisions. Strong TypeScript and React fundamentals, with experience working across the full stack. A track record of independently driving complex features or products from an ambiguous starting point to measurable customer impact. When you encounter a blocker, you investigate, communicate, and find another path forward without waiting to be managed. Strong product and technical judgment. You care about what should be built, how it should feel, and whether it actually solves the problem. You can distinguish between problems that need a sophisticated system and problems that need a simple, well-executed solution. Experience building with LLMs or other applied AI systems in production. An understanding of the challenges behind reliable AI products: evaluation, context, retrieval, model behavior, latency, cost, observability, and failure modes. Clear, proactive communication and the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote environment. Care for software craftsmanship without losing sight of momentum and customer outcomes. Our technology Passionfroot is built primarily in TypeScript across the full stack. Our core product uses React, Remix, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and Zero sync for real-time product experiences. Our AI systems use foundation models from multiple providers alongside the AI SDK, Typesense, and Laminar for search, agent workflows, evaluations, and observability. You don’t need experience with everything we use. We care more about strong fundamentals, relevant product experience, and your ability to learn quickly. What success looks like Within your first months, you will have: Developed a deep understanding of creator-led growth and the problems our customers face. Taken ownership of a major product or technical area with limited oversight. Improved how we build, evaluate, and operate AI-powered functionality. Earned the trust of the team through reliable execution and clear communication. Helped us make better product and technical decisions beyond your immediate projects. A technical walkthrough of a project you know deeply, focused on the decisions and trade-offs you made. A collaborative product and technical problem-solving session with members of the team. A paid work trial based on a realistic problem, which can be completed flexibly around your current commitments. References and offer. We aim to complete the process within one to two weeks. What we offer Competitive salary and equity in a Series A company. Remote-first work with the option to work together in Berlin if you are local. Latest Apple hardware and the tools you need to do your best work. 25 days of paid vacation, plus local public holidays. Regular team events and off-sites—past destinations include Mallorca, Barcelona, the South of France, Berlin, and the Baltic Sea.

title: Senior iOS Developer - Berlin
description: About RA Resident Advisor has been a home for electronic music culture since 2001. Event discovery, ticketing, news and long-form editorial, artist profiles, original films, and a weekly mix series two decades deep. Around 7 million people use the web platform every month, with a wider audience across our apps and other channels. Underneath the platform sits a network of contributors and city managers across dozens of cities, which is how we stay connected to the scenes we cover rather than reporting on them from a distance. RA is 25 years old, independent, B.Corp certified and intent on being indispensable to the artists, promoters and audiences who make this culture. The role You'll be a senior engineer on the RA Guide iOS app: shaping how it's built, leading the technical design of larger features, and raising the bar on quality with the Apps lead. RA Guide is RA's app for browsing events and buying tickets, native on iOS and Android and used by thousands of people every day. We also make RA Scan, a cross-platform app promoters use to scan tickets at the door. You'll join the Apps team: the Apps lead (who also builds on iOS), an Android developer and a product manager, working closely with design and the web teams who build the APIs the app uses. We release weekly. Native releases can't be rolled back once they're out, so we care about getting each one right: tests, careful review, and watching what happens after release. Responsibilities Lead the technical design of larger features, including the specs that line up iOS and Android on the same APIs Own areas of the codebase, and modernise older parts of it safely Raise release quality: automated UI tests on native frameworks, crash analysis and monitoring Review code and mentor other developers Work with the web and platform teams on the APIs the app depends on Help shape how the team uses AI in development, and where it shouldn't. Who we are looking for Several years building and releasing iOS apps used at scale Deep experience with Swift, app architecture and refactoring code that's already live Testing and coding habits for stable app releases You make the developers around you better, through review, pairing and clear explanation You can explain a technical trade-off to product and design in plain terms If you meet most of these but not all, we'd still like to hear from you. We'll help you grow into the rest. Nice to have SwiftUI, reactive programming and GraphQL A/B testing, phased rollouts and data tracking Monitoring tools such as Datadog Android or cross-platform experience An interest in electronic music and the scenes RA serves What we offer you Generous annual leave policies aimed at promoting work-life balance. Matched pension, or 401k for US staff. Comprehensive staff wellbeing initiatives, featuring regular activities and workplace programmes to support mental and physical health. This includes discounted ClassPass memberships and custom-fitted earplugs. Company-led social events, team lunches, and discounts on merch. Paid annual volunteering allowance, encouraging contributions to community projects and charities you care about. A transparent internal company culture committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion (see: https://ra.co/about/diversity ). Active involvement in community projects within the electronic music community (see: https://ra.co/about/community ). More about RA We are independent and we intend to stay that way. 25 years in, RA answers to the culture it came from rather than to outside stakeholders. That is what enables us to make decisions on a long-term basis. Our staff, contributors and international teams are not observers. They are part of the scenes we cover, and that is what we hire for. Craft first, and then a genuine stake in this music rather than just a job in it. RA has been B Corp certified since 2024, which holds us to standards on social and environmental impact we would want to meet regardless of the badge. We especially welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, abilities, ethnicities, experiences, gender identities, and sexual orientations. Our values Electronic music is art. We celebrate the progressive values that underpin electronic music. We advocate for a more inclusive and equitable electronic music community. We honour the past, present and future of electronic music. We use innovation to empower the community. We choose honesty over gain and purpose over profit. We're always front left. This role is a full-time based in our Berlin office. Please note: this position requires applicants to be based in Berlin and to work from the office three days per week. The annual salary range for this role is €70,000- €85,000. If you have questions about the role, please contact [email protected] . This listing will be open for a minimum of two weeks from 25th September. Please be sure to add [email protected] to your contacts and check your junk/spam folder for emails from us.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer / SRE – Kubernetes & Hybrid Cloud (m/f/d)
description: Introduction At a glance Location & work model : Berlin, hybrid Tech stack: Kubernetes on our own servers, Harvester ( KubeVirt ), Argo CD/Flux, Prometheus/Grafana, Longhorn/Ceph Team: A growing SRE team – you report to our CTPO for now and to the Team Lead SRE we're hiring next; two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware Process: Intro call · take-home task (~2h) · 90-min tech interview with our developers · leadership conversation · meet the team Languages: Fluent English required; German is a plus, not a must Why this role is special Most SRE jobs today mean clicking around a managed cloud console. This one doesn't. We run our own hardware in Frankfurt and are building a modern private cloud platform on Kubernetes and Harvester – on-prem by default, with elastic burst into the public cloud and the option to go cloud-only later. You won't inherit a finished SRE practice: you'll help define it, side by side with our Berlin development teams – and you won't do it alone, a Team Lead SRE hire is coming next. SRE here is an enabling discipline: you build what our developers need to ship reliably, while two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware. And the impact is direct – our product discovery technology powers more than 2,000 European online shops (Intersport, SPAR, Douglas and more), handling billions of shopper queries a year. When product discovery is slow or down, our customers lose revenue in real time. Your first 90 days You get to know both products, join the on-call rotation with a buddy, and own your first reliability topic – SLOs for one product, alerting that actually helps at 3 a.m., or automating away a piece of toil. By day 90 you've shipped visible improvements and know where you want to take the platform next. Your mission Define and own SLOs, SLIs and error budgets; drive data-informed reliability decisions Lead incident response end-to-end: fast detection, clear communication, blameless postmortems – and reduce whole classes of incidents structurally, not case by case Eliminate toil through automation and GitOps; evolve our observability (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, runbooks) across two different stacks Help build our custom Kubernetes operator (CRDs) that makes stateful search clusters declarative, self-healing and safely upgradable – and roll out the auto-scaling (HPA/VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler) today's architecture makes hard Plan capacity, performance and cost across on-premises and cloud – including the large-catalogue and peak-season loads our merchants care about – and use AI tools wherever they measurably speed up diagnosis and operations Your profile Must-haves: Kubernetes in production – built, not just used : you've set up and maintained clusters on your own servers (e.g. kubeadm , RKE2, k3s) and know cluster lifecycle and upgrades – managed-only experience isn't enough for this role Lived SRE practice : SLOs, error budgets, incident management, on-call Hands-on experience with GitOps or comparable infrastructure/deployment automation – experience with Argo CD or Flux is a strong plus Solid observability skills – metrics, logs, traces, alerting that people trust A strong automation instinct – you'd rather fix a problem's cause than repeat its workaround A collaborative, enabling mindset – you see SRE as a service to our developers: you ask what they need, discuss trade-offs openly, and don't fall in love with your own solution Nice-to-haves (genuinely optional – we'll teach you the rest): Harvester, KubeVirt , vSphere/ ESXi , OpenStack or similar virtualization/HCI platforms Container storage (Longhorn, Ceph) and datacenter networking (load balancing, ingress, VLAN) Auto-scaling (HPA, VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler ) and capacity/cost planning Experience building Kubernetes operators/CRDs German language skills Certifications (CKA, CKS) are welcome but no substitute for hands-on experience – in the tech interview we'll ask about what you've actually built and operated. You don't tick every box – or your title was never “SRE”? Apply anyway. If you've owned production systems, handled incidents and worked deeply with Kubernetes, we want to hear from you – production experience and engineering mindset matter more to us than titles or buzzwords. THE JOY OF WORKING WITH US Impact from day one: Your work directly influences the revenue of leading eCommerce brands across Europe. Modern tech stack: Kubernetes, Harvester, GitOps, auto-scaling, and an exciting path toward the cloud – with room to build things right. AI-first mindset: We use AI as a real part of our daily work, not as a buzzword. Ownership & growth: Clear responsibility, short decision paths, and the opportunity to actively shape your role. Flexible work: Hybrid work model three office days per week with a focus on outcomes. Strong team: Experienced engineers, an open feedback culture, and an environment where reliability is treated as a real engineering discipline. tags: Product Management | Product Strategy | Senior Product Manager | Product Lead | Wealth Management | WealthTech | Personal Finance | Retail Investing | Portfolio Management | Asset Management | AI Wealth | AI Finance | Subscription Products | Open Banking | Investing | Generative AI | AI advisory | financial advisory | wealth services
description: What we do At getquin, we're on a mission to empower everyone to build wealth. Founded in 2020, we started with a simple idea: help people see their entire financial life in one place, so they can make more informed decisions. Today, getquin has grown into one of the largest wealth platforms globally, already helping over half a million users manage and grow their wealth. Our platform combines analytics, tools and community to make wealth-building accessible for everyone, not just the experts. After launching in Germany, we've started expanding across Europe, with a focus on growing our user base, building valuable new features and helping even more people take control of their financial future. If you're excited to help shape the future of personal wealth management, join us. We're just getting started. What you'll be doing You've built products for investors. You know what a TER actually does to a long-run return, why a user with four brokers has no visbility what they really own, and how differently people behave when the number on screen is their pension rather than their pocket money. You've probably also hit the ceiling of what a chart can tell someone. Better tables, more filters, another allocation donut. The data was always there; the answer never quite arrived. We have something nobody else has: a complete, cross-institution picture of a person's wealth. Investments, cash, liabilities and insurance contracts, in one place, for over half a million users. Your work is turning that into features and insights people understand and act on, and the interesting tools for doing that now include AI. We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own that area. You'll work directly with the founders and the product team, alongside engineering and our financial advisory teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, and you'll mentor less experienced product managers on the team. Own the wealth product area end to end Set the product strategy and roadmap across the picture we give people of their wealth and how we help them optimize it Decide what we build on aggregated portfolio data that nobody with a single-broker view could build at all Own our efforts to stay on the forefront of digital wealth management services and play your part in disrupting a still very offline industry Work the unglamorous, high-leverage problems too: data quality, coverage gaps, missing cost basis, duplicate holdings across connections, ETFs held through more than one broker. A portfolio insight is only as trustworthy as the numbers under it Turn the data into something users act on Define the insights we surface about someone's portfolio, cash position and risk, and why each one earns a place on their screen Own our conversational AI assistant and our AI-driven insights: what they say, what they refuse to say, and how a user knows which is which Set the quality bar for anything we tell a user about their money: accuracy targets, human review, guardrails, rollback. Decide when something is good enough to ship and hold that line when the pressure is to ship anyway Own the numbers Define the metrics for your area: activation, engagement, the insight-to-action funnel, and contribution to subscription conversion and retention Run the experiments, including proper A/B testing, read them, and report what didn't work alongside what did Live in your own product analytics and write your own queries and reporting, rather than wait for someone to give that to you What we are looking for You might be a fit if: You've built wealth management, investing or portfolio products. You know the domain properly: instruments, ETFs, costs, allocation, risk, tax drag, and how retail investors actually behave rather than how they should. This is the requirement we're least flexible on You've owned a product area end to end against a number you defined yourself, with real experimentation behind it You've shipped at least one AI or LLM-based feature to production for real users, and you owned its output quality. You've shipped inside a legal or compliance constraint, and you can reason about where an insight becomes advice. Your product discovery produces evidence, not opinion. You can show us a real research artefact and a decision that changed because of it You're fluent in English; German is a plus You can work from our Berlin office, and you already have the right to work in Germany That usually adds up to around five or more years in product, but we care about the evidence, not the year count. If you came to product from engineering, data science, research, design, financial services, or from a Product Owner role, that counts. Strong plus if you have: PSD2, open banking or account aggregation experience Insurance or brokerage product exposure, which matters as we move into advisory Recommendation systems or personalisation at scale Subscription and paywall experimentation Experience mentoring or coaching other product managers Your own portfolio, and opinions about it If you meet most of this and not all of it, apply. We'd rather read your application than guess. Work authorisation This role requires an existing right to work in Germany. We're not able to sponsor visas or support relocation for this position, so we can only consider candidates who already hold German or EU work authorisation, or who can obtain it independently. We'd rather tell you now than after four conversations. What the first six months look like Month 1: you know the data model, the aggregation layer and its technology behind it. What our analytics do and don't cover, and understand how AI is already being used and where it. You've written down the three things you think are most wrong with the product today Months 2 to 3: a written, agreed area strategy with a prioritised roadmap, a primary metric with a baseline, and, clear metrics that you will be monitoring and optimizing along the way Months 3 to 4: the first thing you scoped is live to a user segment, with a read on the primary metric, and with quality measurement behind it if it involves generated output Months 5 to 6: two or three shipped iterations with measured results, including the ones that didn't work, a quality bar the team applies without you in the room, and at least one junior product manager who's visibly better at their job because of you You won't be measured on shipping volume. You'll be measured on whether your area got measurably more useful and more trustworthy. Why join getquin? Why join getquin? We're a fast-growing B2C fintech, and here, your work has real impact. From day one, you'll take ownership of your domain, ship features end-to-end, and help shape the direction of a product used across Europe. We value initiative, ownership and creativity, not layers of process. Three things that are specifically true of this role: Wealth management is ripe for disruption. Following digitalisation waves of banking and brokerage services, we are leading those efforts across the next big topic for private individuals: better understand and optimize your wealth The data asset is genuinely rare. Aggregated cross-institution wealth for half a million people, with over +€25bn in connected assets. Trade Republic sees its own platform. N26 sees the current account. Nobody else in Europe sees the whole picture, which means there are product questions you can only answer here You'll own the area, not a slice of it. At our size the decisions are yours Ready to build something meaningful? Then join us at the forefront of making wealth building accessible to everyone. How we hire Five conversations, typically three to four weeks from first call to decision. We tell you where you stand after every step, and we respond within seven days at every stage. Recruiter screen, 30 min, video. Role, scope, the salary band, hybrid expectation, notice period, work authorisation. No trick questions Hiring manager, 60 min, video. Your product area ownership, the outcome you drove, and your depth in the wealth domain. This is the first real fit conversation, in both directions Product case, take home. We give you a real getquin problem on aggregated wealth data and work through it together. We know you already have a job, hence we do not impose an in-person case during working hours Cross-functional panel, 2 x 30 min, in our Berlin office. Cover in more depth your case study and deep dive further in your understanding of product metrics and approach to product development. Usually in person in our office. Close conversation, 30 min. Team fit, how you like to work, and whatever is still open, including your questions for a founder Along the last part we will be making reference checks, but only with former employers. Once we have this, we will make you a formal offer. The whole loop runs in English. Tell us if you need any adjustment to the process, whether timing, format or accessibility, and we'll make it. You don't need to explain why.

Du solltest aber Lust haben, mit unseren Technologien zu arbeiten und dich schnell in neue Systeme und Themen einzuarbeiten. Wir suchen keine Person, die jedes Tool schon einmal eingesetzt hat, sondern jemanden, der gute technische Entscheidungen trifft, Zusammenhänge versteht und Verantwortung übernimmt. Qualifikation Du hast fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und beherrschst mindestens eine relevante Programmiersprache sicher. Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Webanwendungen, APIs und Datenbanken. Du interessierst dich für unseren Tech-Stack und hast Lust, dich in Laravel , Statamic , PostgreSQL und Livewire einzuarbeiten oder darin weiterzuentwickeln. Du kannst unterschiedliche Anforderungen und Perspektiven zusammenbringen und sicher mit Stakeholdern umgehen. Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert. Du behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn Anforderungen sich verändern, Informationen zunächst unvollständig sind oder mehrere Themen gleichzeitig auf dem Tisch liegen. Du hast Freude daran, in solchen Situationen Ruhe, Struktur und Verbindlichkeit zu schaffen. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind für die Kommunikation im Team und mit unseren Stakeholdern unerlässlich. Was uns wichtig ist Wir entwickeln nicht zum Selbstzweck. Unser Ziel ist Software, die unmittelbar Wirkung entfaltet: für unser Geschäft, für die Vervielfachung unserer Lizenzen und für unsere Redaktionen, die täglich anspruchsvolle Inhalte produzieren. Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Fragen stellt und sich aktiv einbringt. Gleichzeitig ist uns wichtig, dass du pragmatisch bleibst und gemeinsam mit anderen zu guten Lösungen kommst. title: Product Designer | SimpleStudy
description: Role: Senior Product Designer Company: SimpleStudy Location: Remote, Europe (preferably Western / continental); relocation to Lisbon possible Job Type: Full-time About SimpleStudy SimpleStudy is an AI exam prep platform that students find and choose for themselves. In some numbers: 1.5M+ students across the UK, Ireland, Brazil, South Africa, and Australia 40–50k new students every week Web, mobile, and desktop apps $4M seed round with investors from Strava, OpenAI, and Meta The traction came fast. Now the company is refounding: rebuilding the brand, the design language, and the product experience from scratch. The product grew like a Jenga tower, one feature on top of another. The job now is to rebuild it as a pyramid. The team is ~30 people, remote with a Lisbon office — lean, product-led, and deliberately not a typical edtech company. You'll report to José, the Founding Designer, and work with him as a partner. José tends to lead early framing and direction. You bring strong craft and take the work to the finish line, in close sync with engineering. You both shape the new design language, and you push back with a better idea when you see one. What you are expected to do: Shape the new design language and brand: design system, rebrand, and the new mobile app. Own the full design process — from an ambiguous problem to a polished, shipped solution. Drive the consumer experience: onboarding, social features, retention, and the learning loop. Work in close sync with engineers and PM, not as a handoff step - polish the implementation together until it feels right. Bring your own initiatives and say "no, but…" when you see a better way. Raise the bar for the whole design team. What you need to succeed: High craft — your visual work is polished and intentional; the details reveal your thinking. Storytelling over process — you take an ambiguous problem, frame it, and make it simple. Your portfolio shows artifacts, not diagrams; it has a point of view. Consumer instinct — you've shipped B2C products that people chose to use. You understand product metrics and use them as input, but you lead with feel and craft. Opinions with backbone — you have a design philosophy, can defend it under pushback, and bring your own initiatives. You don't wait to be told what to build. Energy and curiosity — you're an interesting person with a life outside work, and you leave people energised after a conversation. English — fluent, written and spoken. What would be a plus: A standout specialty: prototyping, illustration, animation, or motion. Experience with social or viral product mechanics. Background at consumer companies like Spotify or Strava. Early-stage or founding designer experience. Comfortable in code: prototyping or polishing the front end. What you get: Build from scratch, at scale — a new design language for a product already used by 1.5M+ students. A strong partner - work closely with José, the Founding Designer (ex-Shopify), with direct access to the founders. Equity — generous stock options, early enough for them to matter. Remote Europe — work from where you choose, with in-person meetups three times a year; relocation support if you want to move to Lisbon. Competitive salary — no fixed budget, flexible. How to apply: A deck or a walkthrough video is fine. Show the work, keep it curated. Please email links to your LinkedIn / Resume and portfolio to [email protected] with the subject line [SimpleStudy PD]. We are excited to learn more about you and your work! The vacancy is proudly presented by the hirehire recruiting agency. "Craft matters here from day one. You'll rebuild the brand, the design system and the product together with José, a founding designer who cares a lot about how things feel. 1.5M students, real traction, and a team that picks quality over speed." — Tanya Sivo Product Design Expert, hirehire

title: (Junior) Finance Manager (German Speaking) (m/w/d)
description: DEINE ROLLE Zahlen sind für dich kein Selbstzweck, sondern die Grundlage guter Entscheidungen? Du willst kein kleines Rädchen in einer großen Finanzabteilung sein, sondern echte Verantwortung und tiefe Einblicke in die Abläufe eines FinTechs? Dann bist du bei uns richtig. Als (Junior) Finance Manager (m/w/d) arbeitest du in einem schlagkräftigen, kleinen Finance Team direkt mit dem VP Finance zusammen – und übernimmst von Tag eins an Verantwortung. Von der laufenden Buchhaltung über Monats- und Jahresabschluss bis zu Reporting, Forecasts und der Automatisierung unserer Prozesse deckst du die gesamte Bandbreite ab – und siehst unmittelbar, wie deine Arbeit bei Management, Investoren und Board ankommt. So entwickelst du ein tiefes Verständnis der finanziellen Steuerung eines der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter Europas – und prägst sie aktiv mit. Was machst du dabei konkret? Monatsabschluss: Du übernimmst eigenständig wiederkehrende Reporting- und Abschlussaufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass unser Monatsabschluss steht – pünktlich und verlässlich Jahresabschluss: Du bringst dich in die Vorbereitung des HGB Jahresabschlusses ein und unterstützt unsere Accountants und Wirtschaftsprüfer beim Audit. Reporting: Du erstellst KPIs und Finanzkennzahlen für Management-Präsentationen und wirkst an Investoren- und Board-Unterlagen mit. Analysen: Du baust Finanzmodelle, Forecasts und Abweichungsanalysen und machst aus Zahlen belastbare Insights. Prozessautomatisierung: Du digitalisierst und automatisierst unsere Finanzprozesse u.a. über AI Anwendungen – und findest die Tools, die uns morgen schneller machen. DAS BRINGST DU MIT Erfahrung & Qualifikation: Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung und/oder ein Studium. Erste praktische Erfahrung im Accounting/Controlling, Consulting, Investment Banking oder Venture Capital ist ein Vorteil. Analytische Fähigkeiten: Zahlen sind dein Zuhause: Du denkst analytisch, arbeitest sicher in Excel und findest dich schnell in Tools wie NetSuite, Abacum, Moss oder PowerPoint zurecht. Erfahrung mit Automatisierung und AI Tools ist ein Plus – vieles davon lernst du bei uns on the Job. Mindset: Du bringst eine proaktive, sorgfältige und detailorientierte Arbeitsweise mit und blühst in einem dynamischen, schnell wachsenden Startup Umfeld auf. Du bist ambitioniert, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und ziehst Dinge eigenständig durch. Sprache: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch (mindestens C1) und fühlst dich in einem internationalen Arbeitskontext wohl. So geht es für dich weiter Eine ausgezeichnete Candidate Experience und Transparenz haben für uns im Interviewprozess die höchste Priorität. Die verschiedenen Bewerbungsphasen helfen uns zu verstehen, wie eine Zusammenarbeit aussehen könnte. Erstes virtuelles Kennenlernen mit Larissa: Wir tauschen uns aus, ob Deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen an die Position mit unseren Anforderungen übereinstimmen. Interview mit Jessie : Wir tauchen tiefer in die Rolle und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten ein und lernen uns noch besser kennen. Du hast die Möglichkeit, Fragen zu stellen und mehr über das Internship zu erfahren. Case Study Runde: Gemeinsam mit Jan und einem weiteren Senior Teammitglied wird auf eine typische Situation eingegangen, die Dir in dieser Rolle begegnen könnte. So bekommst Du den bestmöglichen Einblick in den praktischen Alltag. Kennelernen vor Ort: Besuche unser Berliner Büro, lerne die Menschen persönlich kennen, mit denen du eng zusammenarbeiten wirst, und bekomme ein echtes Gefühl für unsere Kultur, unsere Arbeitsweise und unsere gemeinsamen Ziele. Über uns Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit. Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. Mit einem betreuten Vermögen von über 4 Milliarden Euro gehören wir schon jetzt zu den führenden Vermögensverwaltern in Deutschland. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT , Toscafund , HQ Trust und Project A zusammen. LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. Alle qualifizierten Bewerbungen werden ohne Rücksicht auf Hautfarbe, Alter, Religion, Geschlecht, ethnische und nationale Herkunft, Behinderung oder aufgrund von anderen durch Gleichbehandlungsgesetze geschützte Eigenschaften berücksichtigt.

title: Executive Business Partner (m/w/d)
description: About us We're on a mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era. We close critical skill gaps in the workforce, in AI, data, engineering and more, through applied, guided and equitable learning programmes with measurable impact. Multiverse works with over 1,500 leading companies globally to solve business-critical skills challenges. We launched in Germany this year via our acquisition of StackFuel and our ambition is big: upskill 100,000 learners as soon as possible. The role Multiverse Germany's MD Office is looking for a proactive, tech-forward and experienced Executive Business Partner (m/w/d) to support the Managing Director (MD) and Chief of Staff (CoS), to help run a fast-growing Berlin office. Executive and business operations support is the core of this role: your responsibility will lie in managing the diary of the MD and other senior leaders, helping to drive our overall business operations and company rhythm. With competing priorities inevitably arising, this role will require you to use your judgment to prevent unnecessary involvement of the MD in day-to-day situations or proactively involve him or the CoS when urgent. You'll also work closely with the UK team to keep Multiverse Germany aligned with company-wide rhythms. In addition to that, you’ll have the option to help build a high-performance, high-agency culture (e.g., owning the internal event calendar and other initiatives) in the Berlin office. In doing all of the above, automation with AI runs through all of what you’ll do. Wherever a process is repeatable, you're expected and excited to use AI tools to speed things up. Key responsibilities: Support the MD primarily and provide additional support to other senior leaders , as directed, to ensure that company goals and objectives are accomplished and that operations run efficiently Maintain and refine internal processes that support the MD, leadership team and the company Manage professional and personal scheduling for the MD , including calendar management, preparing agendas, drafting emails, preparing phone calls or customer meeting briefings Manage the MDs and senior executives’ travel logistics and activities , including accommodations, transportation, and meals Assist and manage all logistics from end-to-end of small to larger scale events, for example, company All-Hands, leadership offsites or one-off customer events Coordinate closely with the UK and build relationships with UK-based Executive Business Partners, Business Operations Managers and teams so Germany stays aligned with company-wide meeting rhythms and conventions Automate where you can and use AI tools to cut manual admin across scheduling, reporting and follow-up Who you are: You are comfortable in a constantly evolving environment: you can operate in a highly changing, fast-paced environment and prepare decisions, even when things are ambiguous and you can hold multiple threads at the same time You are a strong communicator: you know when to raise a challenge, but even more so, you solve operational challenges them proactively before they reach the CoS or MD You've done this before: several years as an EA, business or operations coordinator, or similar, ideally supporting leaders in a fast-paced or scaling environment You think like an operator: you don't just execute tasks, you build the process, tracker or system behind them: every challenge is a problem about to be solved You default to automation: you look to cut repeatable admin with AI tools rather than doing it by hand You're discreet and trusted: you handle sensitive information with sound judgement You're native or fluent in German, with strong conversational English: this is needed to coordinate closely with the UK team

title: Working Student Analytics Engineer (m/w/d)
description: As a Working Student Analytics Engineer, you will get hands-on with the systems and data that power decisions across the entire business. You will write real SQL, ship production dbt models, help maintain a modern data warehouse, and see your work land in the reports leadership actually runs on. This is a part-time (Werkstudent) role where you take ownership of your own small projects end to end, from raw data to actionable insight, with room to grow your responsibilities as your skills develop. PERGOLUX designs and sells Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, from pergolas to garden furniture, directly to consumers. With around 300 employees, 9-figure revenue, and operations across 8 markets, we build our data systems with the same care and precision as our products, guided by integrity, innovation, ambition, and unity. What You'll Do Help build and maintain our Snowflake data warehouse with dbt, and contribute to the migration of our ERP pipelines Support the team in defining and developing core metrics that steer business performance Build and iterate reports in Looker, turning raw data into insights the business acts on Monitor data health, proactively flagging gaps, freshness issues, and quality problems Take on your own small projects across the stack (Airbyte for ingestion, Snowflake as the warehouse, Python for the messy bits, dbt for transformation and orchestration) and ship them What You'll Bring Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program (Data Science, Statistics, CS, Business Analytics, or related), or a solid self-taught track record Solid SQL fundamentals, comfortable writing complex queries and full-fledged models well beyond a basic SELECT Business intuition: before running a query, you weigh whether asking "why does this number look like that?" will drive real decisions Technical curiosity about end-to-end data architecture and a critical mindset for getting the most out of AI tools while knowing where they fall short, plus professional working proficiency in English Nice to have: exposure to dbt, Airbyte, Snowflake, Looker, or Python; familiarity with e-commerce data (Shopify, Klaviyo, GA4); a GitHub, portfolio, or side project you are proud to talk about 💼 Compensation — Competitive salary · Company pension plan · Capped overtime, fully paid, no endless unpaid crunch 🚀 Growth and Career Development — You will work alongside a lean, senior data team who explain the "why" instead of just handing you tickets, take real ownership of shippable projects from the start, gain full-stack exposure to a modern data platform and a live ERP migration, and build fast-track career momentum and a resume-worthy portfolio as PERGOLUX scales. ⏰ Time Off and Flexibility — Up to 30 vacation days, starting at 27 · One week per year remote workation in EU/UK 🌟 Benefits and Lifestyle International, collaborative team, working with colleagues across Europe Regular team events (summer party, Christmas party, after-work gatherings) and retreats Modern setup and laptops (Apple or Windows) Employee discounts on PERGOLUX products Jobrad / Bike leasing program, promoting sustainable and healthy commuting How to Apply Ready to ship real data work while you study? Apply through our Career Page and connect with us on LinkedIn. We would love to see what you bring to the table. PERGOLUX is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, we think it's less about ticking every box and more about what you bring to the table!

title: Senior AI Product Manager (f/m/d)
description: OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT Building the backbone of European trades together – with AI-first software. We’re not just building software – we’re on a mission to create space for contractors & tradespeople by equipping them with AI solutions that work the way they do: fast, practical, and AI-first. With Tier 1 Investors from Europe and the US, like Headline and Creandum as well as 30,000+ tradespeople as customer base, we’re scaling across Europe to turn scattered tradespeople into thriving communities. We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people in mind who wear the boots, not the suits. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT As a Senior AI Product Manager, you move plancraft closer to becoming the autopilot for the trades : Evolving our product from software that helps tradespeople manage their work into one where AI agents can take on meaningful parts of their daily workload. This is not about adding AI features to an existing roadmap. You’ll own an emerging problem space and identify where agents can create the highest leverage for our customers beyond what Plancraft does today. That means getting close to tradespeople and their businesses, uncovering the problems worth solving, and working with Engineering and UX to turn them into reliable, trustworthy products customers are willing to rely on for real work. You’ll operate across the full product journey: from spending time with tradespeople in the field and deciding which opportunity to pursue, to working with Engineering to understand technical requirements and trade-offs, defining evaluation criteria, shipping to production, and learning from real-world usage. The impact should be tangible. The products you build will aim to help trades businesses improve outcomes such as profit margins, quote acceptance rates, and capacity utilisation — while opening up entirely new product and growth opportunities for plancraft. YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES Own the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery for Plancraft’s customer-facing AI agents and workflows. Identify high-potential customer problems beyond today’s platform and translate messy, real-world trades workflows into focused opportunities for agentic products. Define and own the single co-worker interface for customers to interact with and manage agents and their underlying workflows. Work in a Product Trio with Engineering and UX throughout discovery, evaluation, and delivery, from early problem validation to production-quality releases. Establish a repeatable AI product operating loop across discovery, evaluation, release gates, monitoring, and iteration. Define and maintain evaluation sets, quality standards, and release criteria for customer-facing AI products, including accuracy, correction rates, latency, and safe rollback conditions. Instrument and monitor AI product performance, using customer behaviour and quality signals to decide what to scale, change, or stop. Demonstrate measurable customer outcomes from AI-powered workflows, including improvements in efficiency, profitability, quote acceptance, capacity utilisation, activation, and retention. Contribute the Product perspective to technical and platform trade-offs, including customer value, quality, cost, and time to market, together with Engineering and the shared AI infrastructure counterpart. Partner across Product and Engineering to manage dependencies, reusable AI experience patterns, mobile and voice input, and handovers between customer workflows. Work closely with RevOps, Sales, and Customer Success to understand adoption and willingness-to-pay signals and contribute to AI pricing and monetisation experiments. Must-Have Skills 7+ years of product management experience , including at least 2 years owning and shipping AI products in production end-to-end. Strong applied GenAI literacy across LLMs, agents, RAG, and evaluation frameworks — sufficient to understand technical requirements and help evaluate Product, quality, cost, and time-to-market trade-offs together with Engineering. Experience building 0-to-1 AI products or new product areas , from customer discovery and problem definition through production launch and iteration. Experience defining quality and success criteria for AI products , including evaluation metrics, release thresholds, customer outcomes, and post-launch monitoring. Strong customer discovery and product judgment , with the ability to turn complex real-world workflows into focused AI product opportunities. Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up environment , with a track record of creating structure, setting priorities, and delivering despite ambiguity. Proven cross-functional ownership , working closely with Engineering and UX from discovery through production and managing dependencies across teams. English at C1 level and German at C2 level. Willingness to stay close to customers and the team , including field discovery with tradespeople and regular presence in Hamburg (approximately one week per month or equivalent). Nice-to-Have Skills Experience with voice, mobile, or document AI , particularly products that turn unstructured inputs into reliable workflows. Experience with AI monetisation , including usage-based, credit-based, or hybrid pricing models. Background in B2B SaaS for SMBs, field service, construction, or the trades . Familiarity with product and research tools such as PostHog, Sentry, Dovetail, or ProductFruits . Additional language skills in Italian, Spanish, Dutch, or Polish . WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR You’ll probably enjoy this role if you want to build rather than inherit. You like starting with an important but not fully defined problem and creating clarity through customer insight, data, experimentation, and strong product judgment. You’re excited by AI because of the problems it can solve — not simply because the technology is new. You’re comfortable working closely with engineers, understanding technical requirements and evaluation results, and translating them into sound Product decisions. You want meaningful ownership. You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, narrowing a large opportunity space into the right first wedge, shipping it, learning from real usage, and changing course when the evidence tells you to. And importantly, you want your work to have a visible outcome. The products you build here should change how trades businesses operate — and their adoption, customer value, and commercial impact will be measurable. WHY PLANCRAFT? Team Spirit : We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together. Ownership : You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact. Learning & Growth : We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential. AI Enablement : Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work. Tech & Tooling : You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing. Flexibility : Whether remote, hybrid, abroad or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option. Recharge : To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups. Mobility : You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute. International Environment : We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page . Diversity makes us better. We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for. ______ On the application process We want your candidate experience with us to be smooth, transparent, and enjoyable. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process typically takes about 4 weeks from start to finish, though this may vary by role. You can learn more about our process here . If you need adjustments or flexibility at any stage, please don’t hesitate to let us know — we’ll do our best to make it work for you. Note on creating a test account: If you would like to create a test account as part of the challenge, please enter "Applicant" in the relevant field during registration and select "Other" under Trade. title: Fullstack Software Engineer (M/W/D) – AI-Native Development
