title: Senior Customer Success Manager (all genders)
description: Als VC-backed Foodtech-Startup schaffen wir den Spagat zwischen gesunder Ernährung, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit. Mit unseren Foodjis bringen wir ultrafrische, leckere Gerichte genau dorthin, wo du die meiste Zeit verbringst – denn wir haben uns zum Ziel gesetzt, über 10 Millionen Arbeitnehmern endlich Zugang zu gesunder Ernährung zu ermöglichen und gleichzeitig Foodwaste zu reduzieren. Gestalte das perfekte Foodji-Erlebnis Ein großartiges Produkt allein reicht nicht – echte Kundenzufriedenheit entsteht durch starke Beziehungen und einen klaren Blick auf die Entwicklung des Kundenportfolios. Du machst den konkreten Nutzen und Mehrwert von Foodji sichtbar und schaffst damit die Grundlage für langfristige Partnerschaften. Deine Mission bei Foodji: (Enterprise-) Kund:innen begleitest du von der Testphase über den Vertragsabschluss durch die gesamte Customer Lifetime. Für dein Kundenportfolio übernimmst du Verantwortung und sorgst dafür, dass Kund:innen Foodji erfolgreich nutzen, langfristig bleiben, wachsen und uns weiterempfehlen. Stabile und vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu zentralen Entscheider:innen und dezentralen Stakeholdern baust du gezielt auf und entwickelst sie weiter. Verantwortung für die Gesundheit und Weiterentwicklung deines Enterprise-Kundenportfolios – von der KPI-basierten Analyse der Account Health bis zur Ableitung gezielter Maßnahmen. Vertragsverlängerungen bereitest du aktiv vor und erkennst Kündigungsrisiken frühzeitig – auch wenn sie zunächst nur an einem einzelnen Standort auftreten. Steuerung von internen und crossfunktionalen Projekten zur Weiterentwicklung des Customer Success Bereichs. DAS BRINGST DU MIT Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Success Management sowie nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Retention-, Vertragsverlängerungs- und Churn-Kennzahlen über ein Kundenportfolio hinweg. Strukturierte, datengetriebene und eigenständige Arbeitsweise mit einem guten Gespür für Kundenbeziehungen sowie der Fähigkeit, Risiken, Kundenpotenziale und nächste Schritte selbstständig zu priorisieren. Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, insbesondere Salesforce, sowie sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse. Kommunikationsstärke auf Entscheider:innenebene – auch in anspruchsvollen Gesprächen – sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Multi-Standort-Accounts mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern strategisch zu betreuen. Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse. Präsentations- und Argumentationsfähigkeit sowie ausgeprägte Networking-Kompetenzen. Ein „Do-it“-Mindset, Teamfähigkeit, Selbstbewusstsein sowie eine lösungs- und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise. NOCH FRAGEN? Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter! [email protected] DAS BIETEN WIR Office Foodji & Lunchit App: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office oder Remote Uncapped Bonus: Deine Leistung bestimmt dein Gehalt – nach oben gibt es keine Grenze bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Entwicklungspfade – z. B. vom SDR zum Account Executive Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam! ÜBER UNS Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds. Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst. Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür. Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns. Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt.

description: What we do At Briink , we’re building AI technology for the global sustainability economy. We work with the world’s largest climate organizations, including CDP and PRI, and multinational companies such as Bayer, Siemens, Commerzbank, E.ON, and Heidelberg Materials. Our technology helps automate how sustainability data is collected, analyzed, verified, and acted on. Through our work with global climate organizations, what you build at Briink will directly impact the sustainability workflows of more than 30,000 companies, investors, and cities worldwide. We’re a small team working at enormous scale. Your code won’t sit behind an internal tool or an experimental demo — it will help shape how some of the world’s largest organizations understand and act on their environmental impact. Based at Berlin’s AI Campus, with a second office in London, and backed by over €7 million in funding, we want to prove that some of the world’s most powerful technology can also be a powerful force for good. Application requirement: Intro video As part of your application, please submit a short intro video (max 2 minutes) answering: Who you are and what you have done/built that is relevant for this role. Why you’re excited about owning and shipping AI-powered products at Briink. Why Briink’s sustainability mission resonates with you. Upload your video using this form (YouTube unlisted, Loom, or any other solution is fine). We do this to get a better sense of candidates before continuing the process. Any application without a video will not be considered ;) Your role As Briink’s Backend/AI Product Engineer , you’ll join a small, high-ownership product and engineering team building AI-powered products for sustainability professionals. This is not a narrowly scoped backend role. You’ll take meaningful product problems from initial discovery and user conversations through technical design, implementation, and iteration to deploy them at scale across the ESG market. You’ll combine strong backend and AI/LLM engineering with product judgement and the initiative to work out what should be built - not just how to action a predefined ticket. You will: Own product features end to end , from understanding the user problem and defining the right approach through to delivery, measurement, and improvement. Design and build scalable backend systems , including APIs, data models, workflows, and infrastructure for complex enterprise products. Build and ship applied AI/LLM features , such as LLM chains, RAG systems, tool-using agents, structured-output pipelines, and evaluation workflows Create reusable, extensible platform building blocks that support multiple user journeys and reporting workflows rather than solving each problem in isolation. Improve the robustness of our systems , strengthening reliability, testing, observability, performance, and maintainability as we scale. Work directly with users, product, and data , using qualitative feedback and product data to understand the real problem and evaluate whether a solution works. Prototype and test new AI capabilities , turning promising ideas into practical product improvements that accelerate our roadmap. Bring thoughtful opinions and constructive challenge , helping the team make better product and technical decisions. Collaborate closely with other engineers , including through pair programming, technical design discussions, and shared problem-solving. Your profile Technical requirements Strong professional backend engineering experience , with a track record of designing and shipping reliable production systems. Experience in a small, high-ownership product team , ideally within a startup or scale-up engineering organisation of roughly 5–20 engineers. Evidence that you have shipped meaningful products end to end , rather than owning only a narrow component within a much larger organisation. Strong experience in Python (or another modern backend language such as Java, Ruby, or TypeScript, combined with the ability and willingness to become productive in Python quickly). Strong API, database, and systems design skills , with the ability to model complex workflows and build maintainable foundations for enterprise products. Applied AI/LLM experience : you have experience or a strong interest in LLM-powered features, ideally involving RAG or retrieval, tool use, agents, structured outputs, or evaluation systems. A solid software-quality mindset , including testing, code review, CI/CD, observability, and pragmatic approaches to reliability and security. Cloud and container experience , with an understanding of how to deploy, operate, and scale production workloads. Fluent English (C1+) , both written and spoken. Nice to have Experience building workflow, reporting, questionnaire, or other complex B2B SaaS products . Familiarity with backend technologies such as FastAPI, PostgreSQL, background queues Any experience with LangChain, LangSmith, or other LLM frameworks Deeper experience with RAG, retrieval, agents, LLM evaluation, and production AI systems . Experience improving latency, cost, and reliability for AI workloads. Knowledge of ESG, sustainability, climate tech, or corporate reporting . German language skills. Who you are Kind and collaborative : You treat people well, communicate clearly, and help create a supportive, low-ego team environment. Mission-driven : You care about using technology to accelerate sustainability and climate action. Sharp and curious : You learn quickly, ask good questions, and enjoy getting to the root of difficult product and technical problems. A product-minded builder : You think beyond the task in front of you, focus on the user’s real problem, and care about whether what you ship creates value. Highly self-directed : You thrive in a fast-moving environment with autonomy, ambiguity, and limited oversight. Pragmatic and action-oriented : You can move from ideas to experiments to production without waiting for perfect requirements. Opinionated but open-minded : You challenge ideas constructively, welcome pushback, and enjoy thinking through problems with others. Commercially aware and creative : You balance technical quality with user needs, business value, and speed. If your experience doesn’t align precisely with all the criteria, don't worry! We encourage you to still apply. Many people miss out on opportunities because they feel they don’t fit every requirement—we believe in attitude, growth and iteration, not perfection! What we offer Competitive salary and equity , reflecting your impact and ownership. Purpose-driven mission : Build tools that help organisations act more sustainably and make the ESG data ecosystem more transparent. Flexible hybrid setup : Berlin or London based candidates are strongly preferred, with access to our team and the wider startup community at the Merantix AI Campus. Trust and autonomy : Own meaningful problems, shape the product, and influence how we build as the company grows. A genuinely high-impact role : Increase our delivery capacity, strengthen the robustness of our platform, and accelerate product innovation. Dynamic environment : Work in a small, ambitious team at the intersection of applied AI, enterprise software, and sustainability. Learning budget and quarterly hackathons : Explore new technologies and prototype ideas that push Briink forward. A thoughtful hiring process : We are focused on finding the right person, and are willing to take the time needed to do so.

title: Senior Product Manager (ISR) Defence & Intelligence (f/m/x)
description: Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO We are looking for a Senior Product Manager ( ISR ) (f/m/x) to own the product and delivery side of LiveEO's defence and intelligence business. Sektion 4 builds AI-based ISR capabilities for German and allied defence and intelligence customers: object and change detection in very high resolution satellite imagery, 3D terrain products derived from stereo imagery, and the analytics that turn imagery into decisions. You will run our customer-facing defence products end to end from a product management perspective including analytical products as well as end user applications. You will also build the roadmap that connects different customer timelines, our concept of operations and the actual maturity of our technical components into one plan that engineering and sales both work from. This role exists because our LiveEO engineers build world class AI models and your work will help to bring them into operations and roll them out to many more end users. We need someone who can say how an analyst does the job, write requirements a military user would recognise, and hold the line on what we ship. LiveEO is a dynamic team that thrives on big challenges and fast learning cycles. We move quickly, stay curious, and genuinely enjoy building together. We are on a mission to break the "curse of Earth Observation": turning incredible satellite data into reliable, actionable decisions that people can trust and use in real operations on scale. You will be part of Sektion 4, LiveEO's government-solutions product team. Sektion 4 owns its roadmap and delivers funded R&D projects and defence engagements end-to-end, from research through to production, and sets its own technical direction. You will work day to day with the team's ML engineergs, full-stack engineers and geospatial data egineers, and across LiveEO with sales, pre-sales and the teams building the Twinspector satellite programme. Externally you are in front of military and agency users, partners and integrators, in workshops, requirement sessions and user tests. Tech stack & tools: Linear (backlog, sprints) Confluence Google Workspace LiveEO's own ISR and analytics applications Figma QGIS and comparable viewers STAC -based imagery catalogs Data: very high resolution optical imagery synthetic aperture radar 3D surface models cloud and secure on-premise / air-gapped deployments agentic tools for a variety of work. Your challenge As Product Manager (f/m/x), you own what we build for defence and intelligence customers, and you are accountable for it reaching them. Own the ISR product: take our imagery intelligence application from working demonstrator to deployable product. Define the release scope, the deployment and support model for secure on-premise environments, and drive the first installation at a real user. Run the backlog: work with the engineering team in two-week sprints. Translate operational needs into written requirements and user stories, prioritise ruthlessly, cut scope when it is the right call, and keep the team pointed at what matters. Deliver defence projects end to end: own scope, milestones, deliverables and stakeholder communication for our customer-facing defence engagements, and take on new projects as the pipeline converts. Build and maintain the roadmap: reconcile project timelines, our concept of operations and component readiness into one roadmap that is used to set priorities, not to describe them afterwards. Be the ISR authority in the team: bring operational depth on the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and imagery exploitation. Be the person engineering asks how an analyst would really use this, and the person sales asks what we can credibly claim. Work with users and customers: run workshops and user sessions, gather and structure feedback, demonstrate the product, and support bids and proposals with operational substance. Your profile Professional ISR , GEOINT or IMINT background: Bundeswehr, the intelligence community, defence procurement, or an ISR role in industry. Real operational fluency in the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and how imagery products are produced and consumed at a staff. Proven ability to translate operational needs into written requirements that engineers can build from. Track record of driving work to a deadline across dependencies you did not control. German at native or fully fluent level, and professional English. German or European citizenship and eligibility to obtain a German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung). Willingness to work on-site in Berlin, hybrid with at least two days per week in the office, and to travel within Germany to customers and users. You take ownership and proactively push work forward. You communicate clearly and collaborate smoothly within and across teams. Pragmatic mindset: you balance operational ambition with what can actually be shipped. You enjoy working with complexity and turning ambiguity into structure. Product management or product ownership experience: backlog, sprint cadence, release scoping is a plus. Project management experience in defence or publicly funded programmes (national, EU, NATO) is a plus. Experience writing CONOPS , operational requirements or capability documents is a plus. Familiarity with satellite imagery, remote sensing, or AI and machine learning products is a plus. Experience delivering software into secure on-premise or air-gapped environments is a plus. An existing valid German security clearance (SÜ2 / SÜ3) is a plus. Working knowledge of NATO standards and interoperability for imagery and geospatial data is a plus. Your Benefits The opportunity to create a product that can improve business processes and lives across the globe. Flexible working hours and hybrid work model - we trust our employees to get their work done while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. We empower employees to drive their own career development, take initiative and have the freedom to be creative and bold. Not an overtime culture - we take care that overtime is done only as a necessity and always offset with time off and rest. A collaborative and learning environment - frequent internal workshops, knowledge sharing sessions, journal clubs and hackathons. Office located in the centre of Berlin Kreuzberg with free fruit, nuts and drinks. Potential to participate in the employee stock option program. Urban Sports membership and BVG subsidy, corporate pension program. A diverse and vibrant international environment of 30+ different nationalities

title: Senior Finance & FP&A Manager
description: Mission Integral was founded in October 2024 and is already one of the fastest-growing startups in Germany. We're building the leading AI-native platform for accounting, payroll, and tax for European SMEs, and we're looking for the sharpest people to help us get there. As our first dedicated Senior Finance & FP&A Manager, you will build the financial planning & analysis function from the ground up and report directly to the CFO. You will own the group's forecasting and planning engine, sharpen ARR and liquidity steering, and be a core partner on fundraising, board reporting and go-to-market economics. This is a high-visibility, high-autonomy role for someone who wants to build. Your Tasks Planning & forecasting: Own and continuously improve the integrated business plan (P&L, cash flow, balance sheet), including consolidation logic. Budgeting: Run the annual budget and rolling re-forecast; translate strategy into a defensible operating plan and use-of-funds. Performance steering with KPIs & BI: Define and report the KPIs that matter and build them into our BI dashboard. Flag risks and levers early. IR & fundraising: Support board and investor reporting and potential future funding rounds with models and investor-grade materials. GTM & cohorts: Build and own cohort analytics tied to go-to-market (e.g. retention, payback period, LTV/CAC and margin by acquisition channel). Turn these into concrete recommendations on spend and channel mix. Business partnering: Partner with Commercial and Service Operations leaders on unit economics, pricing, funnel efficiency and investment decisions. Scalable processes & automation: Design processes that scale with rapid growth by using AI and agentic tooling to make planning faster, cleaner and repeatable. Operational Finance: Own accounts payable and receivable, and drive timely, accurate month-end and year-end closes together with our tax advisory team. Your Profile Experience: 5+ years in FP&A, accounting/controlling, investment banking or a comparable analytical finance role, ideally with high-growth / VC-backed / scale-up exposure. Modelling: Expert financial modelling; you build clean, three-statement models and defend the assumptions. Commercial: Fluent in unit economics, recurring-revenue and cash metrics; comfortable turning messy data into decisions. Tools: Advanced Excel/Sheets; experience with BI/planning, DATEV and AI tooling a strong plus. Language: You operate in English and German; investor and board materials are produced in English. Mindset: Hands-on, structured, comfortable with ambiguity and first-of-role ownership in a scaling environment. Agentic mindset: You default to AI and agentic tools to automate the repetitive and build leverage - you think in reusable processes and systems, not one-off spreadsheets, so finance scales faster than headcount. Qualification: Degree in finance, business or a quantitative field; CFA, MBA or qualified-accountant background welcome. What we're not looking for People who wait to be told what to do. "That's not my job" energy at the handoff between teams. Anyone who treats compliance and documentation as red tape to skip rather than the thing that protects the client. Process We move fast. For the right candidate the whole process takes less than two weeks. title: Platform Engineer
description: About finmid At finmid, we’re building infrastructure that integrates access to capital for SMEs directly into the platforms they use daily. We leverage technology, data, and strategic partnerships to deliver financing solutions that significantly outperform traditional financial services - offering SMEs faster, simpler, and more transparent access to funding. As we expand across Europe, our Latvian subsidiary, licensed as a European Crowdfunding Service Provider by the Bank of Latvia, plays a critical role. Our stack combines regulated financial infrastructure with modern software engineering. The gap between those two things is exactly where this role lives. The Role We're looking for a Platform Engineer who wants to own the infrastructure that makes everything else possible. You'll build and maintain the systems our engineering teams rely on every day — CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, data tooling, AI integrations, and developer experience as a whole. This isn't a "keep the lights on" role. You'll design systems from scratch, introduce new tools, and have a direct say in how we build software. What You Will Work On Architect and manage our cloud infrastructure on AWS and Kubernetes. Build and improve CI/CD pipelines, developer tooling, and internal platforms. Evaluate, integrate, and roll out new tools and services across the company. Partner with product and business teams to remove bottlenecks and ship faster. Own production systems end-to-end — from design decisions to incident response. Raise the bar on security, observability, and engineering standards. What you need to be successful We care far more about how you think than what you already know. Languages and tools can be learned — curiosity and drive can't. You're a pragmatist. You find the simplest solution that actually works, not the most impressive one. You're comfortable with infrastructure. You have hands-on experience with containers, orchestration, and cloud platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, or similar). You write clean, maintainable code. We mostly work in Kotlin and TypeScript, but we won't filter you out over a language. You communicate well. You can explain technical decisions to non-technical people and collaborate across teams without friction. You want to grow. You're not looking for a role where you do the same thing every day. You want to stretch. Bonus points for Experience with financial services, payments, or regulated environments. Familiarity with managing micro-services running on JVM runtime. A track record of driving projects from idea to production. Experience working in distributed / remote teams. Benefits We see ourselves as “distributed first” but also have a beautiful office in Berlin where you can work. We are flexible and cover whatever you need to be as productive as possible (e.g., MacOS, IntelliJ IDEA, Claude Code). Home office stipend. 30 days’ of time off. Meaningful equity. Open-minded and transparent culture that includes regular get-together meetings (e.g., All Hands, Brown Bag Lunch, Offsites).

You will acquire business and individual customers across European markets and own the commercial process end-to-end: identify and engage prospects, run discovery, demonstrate the product in person, design the right commercial and operating model for each customer, build proposals, negotiate, and close. Our customers can look very different. One week, you may be discussing a fleet deployment with a taxi or car-sharing company. The next, you may be showing the vehicle to a real-estate company, law firm, mobility operator, or prospective individual customer. This is not a role where you inherit a mature market, established category, and optimized sales playbook. Driverless technology is only getting started in Europe. You will need to understand unfamiliar customer problems quickly, figure out how Bliq can solve them, and help us discover how this technology should be sold. You will work closely with the Commercial Lead and founders to refine Bliq’s sales playbook market by market. Responsibilities Own the sales cycle from first conversation through signed contract Build pipeline through targeted outbound and proactive prospecting across European markets Run sharp discovery conversations that uncover customer operations, economics, pain points, and decision criteria Conduct live Bliq vehicle demos and turn the experience into a compelling commercial conversation Develop deployment concepts together with prospects, including use case, fleet size, operating model, responsibilities, economics, and rollout plan Create proposals, commercial models, LOIs, and contracts together with the relevant internal teams Navigate complex buying processes involving operators, management teams, fleet owners, partners, and other stakeholders Build relationships with customers across mobility, taxi, car sharing, rental, real estate, professional services, and other relevant sectors Own defined markets and be accountable for commercial progress within them Keep CRM data, pipeline, next steps, and forecasts accurate Test new segments, messages, channels, and commercial models and turn what works into repeatable processes Work closely with the Customer Deployment team to make sure signed customers can actually be deployed successfully Represent Bliq at customer meetings, industry events, demos, and market visits across Europe Support B2C sales initiatives when they become part of the GTM strategy Bring customer feedback directly into Bliq’s product, operations, and commercial decisions Your profile Apply if this describes you: You have at least 2 years of Account Executive or comparable full-cycle sales experience You are a hunter and enjoy creating opportunities rather than waiting for inbound demand You learn quickly and can become credible on a complex technical product without hiding behind technical jargon You are excellent face-to-face and comfortable walking into an important customer meeting, running the room, and demonstrating a physical product You are customer-first and care about finding solutions that make customers satisfied You have strong commercial judgment and understand how to turn customer needs into a viable deal You write clearly and can produce concise, convincing emails, proposals, and commercial documents You are highly organized and detail-oriented; pipeline hygiene, follow-ups, and commitments do not get lost You have CRM experience and understand disciplined sales processes Experience with tools such as Clay, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar is a plus You know how to use AI to research, prepare, analyze, and move faster while keeping the thinking and customer judgment your own You have a figure-it-out mindset and remain effective when there is no existing template for the problem You are comfortable owning a market or commercial project and being measured by the outcome You can work professionally in German and English; additional European languages are a plus You are based in Berlin You are willing to travel regularly across Europe Experience selling hardware, mobility, automotive, physical technology, or other operationally complex products is a strong plus This role will probably not suit you if you want an established sales process, a narrowly defined territory, a predictable product demo, or a manager telling you exactly what to do next. It will suit you if you want to help create a category, sell something people can experience in the real world, and build the commercial machine while running it. Why us? Sell a product people are excited about Build Bliq’s sales playbook together with the Commercial Lead Work directly with the founders and senior team Own meaningful customer relationships and markets from an early stage Work on complex deals combining technology, vehicles, operations, economics, and regulation See deals move from your first message to vehicles operating on public roads with the customer Fast decisions, direct feedback, and no bureaucracy Strong compensation package with meaningful upside for performance Significant room to grow as Bliq expands across European markets Tips for a successful application Show us that you can sell. Generic applications tell us very little. Tell us what you have personally owned and what results you produced. If you have built pipeline, opened a new market, sold a difficult product, or closed an unusual deal, tell us how. Use AI as a tool. Make sure the thinking and personality in your application are yours.

title: Automation Engineer (gn) Industrial Robotics & Software Development
tags: Automation | Robotics | Software | SaaS | Platform | PLC | Python
description: Your mission At Wandelbots, we combine modern software development with industrial robotics and automation. With NOVA, we are building a platform that makes the use of industrial robots easier, more flexible, and more software-driven. As an Automation Engineer , you will work right at this intersection: You will commission automation systems and robots, support our teams with your hands-on industrial expertise, and implement customer-specific solutions based on NOVA. You will support projects from technical concept and implementation through to commissioning at the customer site, while bringing insights from real-world automation projects back into our product and engineering teams. WHAT YOU WILL DO Industrial Robotics & Automation You will be responsible for the setup, commissioning, and operation of internal and customer automation systems. Your responsibilities will include: Configuring, parameterizing, and commissioning industrial robots from different manufacturers on our shop floor and at customer sites Integrating robots, PLCs, and other peripheral devices into an automation environment Supporting electrical commissioning, troubleshooting, maintenance, and on-site customer deployments Acting as a technical point of contact for robotics and industrial automation across our teams Bringing practical experience from customer projects into technical and product related decisions NOVA & Software Development You will use Wandelbots NOVA to implement customer-specific robotics and automation solutions and bring an important application perspective into our product development. Your responsibilities will include: Translating customer robotics requirements into NOVA-based software solutions Developing project-specific applications, workflows, and functionality using Python Combining and applying existing NOVA capabilities to real industrial use cases Working closely with Software, Product, and Robotics Engineering on new use cases and technical challenges Providing structured feedback from real-world projects and turning project learnings into reusable solutions and best practices Your profile You have hands-on experience in industrial robotics and automation and enjoy working at the intersection of automation and software. Ideally, you bring: Strong knowledge of industrial robot programming, parameterization, and commissioning Practical experience with at least one major robot manufacturer such as KUKA, ABB, Yaskawa, FANUC, or Stäubli Experience with industrial automation systems and customer-site commissioning Basic knowledge of PLC programming and electrical commissioning Good knowledge of Python A basic understanding of software architecture and modern development practices Ideally, a qualification as a certified electrical specialist / qualified electrician or a comparable qualification A hands-on, solution-oriented mindset and openness to modern development and AI assisted tools What else is important German language skills at B2 level or above English language skills at B2 level or above Willingness to regularly work on-site at customer locations and support commissioning activities Enjoyment of working across different teams, including Software Development, Robotics, Product, and Customer Projects Your Profile Is Particularly Interesting to Us If … You have worked with several different robot manufacturers You have supported complete automation systems from planning through to commissioning You are equally interested in traditional automation and software development You have experience with industrial communication systems and interfaces You enjoy working directly with customers, software developers, and automation specialists You want to do more than just experiment with new technologies and are motivated to bring them into real production environments Why This Role? This role combines two areas that are increasingly converging in industrial automation: robotics and software development. You will work with real industrial robots and automation systems while also developing NOVA-based solutions for concrete customer applications. This gives you the opportunity to bring the perspective of an industrial user directly into our software and product development. In doing so, you will help us ensure that NOVA is not only technologically powerful, but also consistently aligned with the needs of real-world industrial automation projects. Why us? Make an impact! Work on an innovative, deep tech product that adds value to the robotics world and to society! Become a crucial part of something new, big and exciting where you can truly make an impact! Our teams inspire! Cross-functional communication is key. You'll get to know many of your 100+ colleagues. Collaborate with great people on our international teams who value knowledge sharing and unique ways of doing things! Be authentic! Work in a value-driven environment where everything may not be perfect, but we're working on it! Your feedback is required while you receive feedback and appreciation for your work! Help others! You can have up to 3 days of volunteer time off to help your favorite charity. Develop yourself! We offer training and mental health opportunities so that you can develop both mentally and professionally. And there is even more! Enjoy our free lunch, snacks and drinks, team events, 30 days of annual vacation + additional rest during Christmas season until New Year. If your child gets sick, we assure that a 100% of your usual earnings will be paid while you take care of your little one.

title: Senior Software Engineer – IT Banking & Payment Operations

Independent Work: With short decision-making paths, we enable you to work autonomously and actively contribute your ideas – we provide space for you to take on responsibility. Grow with Us: Unlock your potential with numerous opportunities for growth and development, along with an annual development budget to help you achieve your professional and personal goals. Team Spirit: Team spirit is important to us – we regularly host events and parties where fun is guaranteed. description: Role Hive Robotics is building Europe’s first full-stack orchestration platform for unmanned systems: connecting, controlling, and commanding multi-vendor drone and robot swarms. You take over our existing customer accounts and drive the opportunities our founders and Business Development have opened, with the first new deals expected to close within 3 months. Our founders and Business Development open doors with customers, partners and the wider ecosystem. You will act as a security enabler across all Product & Engineering. Investigate reported vulnerabilities at the code level, including our Rust core, Go and Python tooling. Monitor, investigate, and respond to security alerts across AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and related infrastructure. Track and report security metrics (vulnerability remediation SLAs, MTTR, patch latency, critical findings) and keep reporting current for the Security Officer. On-call expectations are low: there is no formal rotation, though occasional availability for high-severity incidents is expected. Who you are You can read and navigate an unfamiliar codebase (Rust, Go, Python) well enough to validate a vulnerability report, trace its impact, and judge whether a proposed fix actually closes it. You write and maintain automation and security tooling comfortably, and can hold a credible technical conversation in code review. Experience triaging vulnerability reports or working with a bug bounty program, vulnerability disclosure program, product security team, or similar function. Practical knowledge of cloud and container security, particularly AWS and Kubernetes. Familiarity with GitHub security features and securing CI/CD pipelines. The ability to investigate alerts and vulnerabilities methodically, distinguish genuine risk from noise, and recommend proportionate remediation. Clear written communication skills for working with external researchers and internal engineering teams. A self-directed approach and comfort independently managing a security queue. 3+ years in a hands-on security engineering, product security, or vulnerability management role. Nice to have An offensive security background, such as penetration testing, CTF participation, vulnerability research, or exploit analysis. Experience working in an open-source company or contributing security improvements to open-source projects. Familiarity with cloud-native incident response. Why join us A remote-first, international team working on cutting-edge AI infrastructure. A competitive salary with additional perks. Flexible working hours and async-friendly culture. title: Customer Success Manager
description: Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. The AI Customer Success function is being built from the ground up, and this role will help define it internationally. As the first Customer Success Manager in this area, you will own the end-to-end post-sale experience for a portfolio of customers that includes some of the world’s most sophisticated cyber threat intelligence teams and investigators, national security agencies, and financial crime teams. Your mandate is not just to manage accounts—you will help establish the playbook, define what success looks like, and drive a product-led growth motion that turns new customers into long-term, expanding partners. The impact you will have: Build and ship a v1 onboarding playbook within the first 30 days—a practical, working version built from early customer engagements that can be iterated as you learn what drives adoption across international customer segments. Use AI to build production CS workflows that pull from ChurnZero, Salesforce, Gong, and product usage telemetry to auto-generate account health summaries and QBR drafts—compressing hours of reporting preparation into minutes so you can spend your time on the work that actually requires human judgment. Define and track adoption benchmarks across the portfolio—hands-on-keyboard usage, consumption rates, and account-specific success metrics—and surface at-risk accounts before renewal decisions are made. Identify and scope the highest-impact PLG play within 60 days by working backwards from expansion targets, focusing on the one or two use cases most likely to drive consumption across the customer base. Run executive business reviews and QBRs with senior stakeholders at government agencies and financial institutions internationally—building the trust and credibility that turns TRM from a vendor into a mission-critical partner. Partner with ADs on expansion plays, co-own NRR targets, and build the structured path to proving value for every customer with an expiring or at-risk contract. Close the feedback loop between customers and Product—synthesize adoption blockers, feature gaps, and new use-case opportunities into prioritized, actionable input that informs the roadmap. Design the CS infrastructure and tooling stack that scales as the product grows—you are building the foundation the next CSM hire will inherit. What we're looking for: Background in cyber or cyber threat intelligence, intelligence agencies, financial crime investigations, or regulatory and compliance environments. 5+ years as an onboarding engineer, customer success manager, deployment strategist, or in another post-sale role with proven ownership of NRR, GRR, and expansion metrics—you have the track record, not just the title. Domain credibility in cyber, national security, or financial crime—you can walk into a room of investigators and earn their trust in the first meeting, not the fifth. Demonstrated zero-to-one builder experience—you have built a CS function, onboarding playbook, or PLG motion from scratch and can point to the specific outcomes it drove. Production AI fluency—you have built real, repeatable AI workflows, not just experiments, that synthesize data from multiple sources into outputs that run consistently and deliver measurable results. You can show the workflow, explain the data logic, and articulate where human judgment stays in the loop. A high level of independence—you set your own agenda, operate without needing constant direction, and ship v1 before you have all the answers. Strong executive presence—you can run a QBR with a senior government stakeholder or financial institution executive and command the room through substance, not just polish. Experience supporting international customers, with the ability to navigate regional, cultural, and time-zone differences. About the Team: This team focuses on TRM’s AI-driven Intel platform, supporting investigators and cyber teams working on complex cases involving cyber threats. This is the first Customer Success hire dedicated to international customers—you will help build the function from the ground up, with high autonomy, direct access to leadership, and meaningful influence on how TRM approaches customer success globally. The broader TRM CS organization operates distributed, not distant—async-first communication through Slack, strong documentation, and intentional synchronous time for key decisions. You will work directly with the Head of Customer Success and Patrick South, CRO, with close day-to-day collaboration with international Sales teams and Product. Team Operating Rhythms: As a globally distributed team, members work across multiple time zones. This role will primarily align its working hours and customer coverage with international markets, with flexibility to collaborate across regions when needed. Our Customer Success team is fully remote, thriving on asynchronous communication and collaboration through Slack channels and detailed documentation. We hold weekly customer syncs, biweekly health syncs, join our associated POD calls, and regularly engage with customers across international markets. As experts in our craft, we focus on providing support, driving value, and building meaningful relationships with our customers as trusted advisors. We are on the front lines of TRM, ensuring our customers get the most out of the product and bringing valuable insights back to the team. The team moves fast and iterates—v1 ships before it is perfect, and feedback is expected to be direct and specific. On-Call Responsibilities: End-to-End Ownership: While there is no formal hourly rotation, you will be the primary lead for your area and responsible for customer success across international markets. This requires a high degree of agency and a commitment to seeing mission-critical tasks through to resolution, including the flexibility to handle urgent needs outside of standard hours or on weekends when they arise. Learn about TRM Speed in this position: Within 30 days of joining, you ship a working v1 onboarding playbook built from your first 2–3 accounts—not a slide deck, but a live document with measurable adoption benchmarks that the account team is already using to set customer expectations. Within 6 weeks, you share a draft success-metrics framework at 50% complete with the account team and key customers to validate direction—getting real signal on what drives credit consumption before investing further in building out the full playbook. Within 60 days, you identify and scope the highest-impact PLG play by working backwards from expansion targets—presenting a concrete recommendation to leadership on which use case to prioritize and why, grounded in actual account data from international customers. Application Instructions If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team. Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your qualifications for the role. If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure you’re considered. What to Expect From Our Interview Process Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while giving you the opportunity to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, AI skills assessment, and Leadership Principles interview. Recruiter Intro: Explore your experience, motivations, and alignment with the role. Hiring Manager: Dive deeper into your relevant experience, skills, and impact. First Round: Typically 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role. Final Round: Typically 3–5 interviews to go deeper on your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM. References: We’ll speak with former colleagues who can provide perspective on your work and impact. Offer: If it’s a mutual fit, your recruiter will walk you through your offer and answer your questions. Welcome to TRM: Once you sign, we’ll get you ready for your first day and onboarding. Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way. Learn more about interviewing at TRM Life at TRM We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day. TRM moves quickly. We are a high velocity, high ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days. Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving. At TRM, you should expect: Priorities and targets to change quickly as we experiment and iterate Work that often requires operating with a high degree of ambiguity A high level of personal ownership and accountability Close collaboration across teams and functions Frequent, high-touch communication Creative problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires comfort navigating ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment. We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here. At the same time, many people find this work deeply rewarding. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks. At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to: Accelerate repeatable workflows Structure and solve problems Improve output quality Increase speed and leverage You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process. Leadership Principles We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions. Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly. Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday. Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger. Join our Mission At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast. TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. title: Tech Lead (f/d/m)
description: A definitive shift is currently happening. Corporates across the globe are no longer just reporting on sustainability; they are actively investing in it as a core financial and strategic asset. At CEEZER, we are architecting the infrastructure for enterprise-grade Climate Performance Asset management, transforming how the world's largest companies source and manage carbon credits, Energy Attribution Certificates (EAC), and Sustainable Aviation Fuel certificates (SAFc). Our platform gives the world’s most ambitious enterprises the data-driven precision, real-time monitoring, and framework-compliant reporting required to confidently deploy capital toward high-impact Climate Performance Asset portfolios and true, measurable climate action. Tasks Your mission We are looking for a Tech Lead to join our engineering team. This role requires an ambitious technical leader who can architect scalable systems, navigate complex carbon data architectures, and drive engineering excellence. Moving beyond traditional software delivery, you will translate product vision into reliable technology, lead critical architectural decisions, and leave a lasting mark on our platform from day one. Architect and scale a seamless B2B procurement platform, delivering an intuitive, enterprise-grade user interface designed for daily engagement and complex workflows. Drive end-to-end technical strategy, design, and architecture, translating ambitious product requirements into performant, scalable features and microservices. Lead by example with hands-on technical execution, authoring high-quality, maintainable code across our TypeScript, Node.js, and Next.js stack. Cultivate engineering excellence across the team, providing high-impact mentorship, technical guidance, and rigorous code reviews to continuously elevate development standards. Safeguard platform integrity, establishing robust security, reliability, and performance standards across our applications and core cloud infrastructure. Partner closely with product, design, and cross-functional teams, evaluating trade-offs and technical permutations to engineer optimal, user-centric solutions. Requirements What you need to succeed 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of technical leadership (2+ years) guiding teams through complex, full-lifecycle product deliveries. Deep technical proficiency in TypeScript and the Node.js ecosystem, alongside extensive hands-on experience building modern, data-dense interfaces with React or Next.js. Strong architectural expertise in RESTful API design, backend systems architecture, and relational data modelling (PostgreSQL experience preferred). Demonstrated commitment to engineering rigour, with a deep understanding of software design patterns, enterprise web security standards, and modern development workflows (Git, feature branching). Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure and continuous deployment, including hands-on experience building and maintaining services on platforms like AWS. Exceptional collaborative and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical decisions, bridge alignment across product teams, and mentor engineers. Basic familiarity with Python is a plus, or a strong technical curiosity to expand into auxiliary parts of our data processing stack. Benefits What's in it for you at CEEZER? A mission that matters: Work alongside international teams combining finance, tech, and climate science professionals to direct capital toward the world's most critical climate assets. Accelerated growth: We are scaling fast, and your career will too. Take opportunities to lead cross-functional initiatives and expand your strategic influence. True ownership: We are building in a brand-new market, meaning many of our best practices don’t exist yet. If you see a better workflow, tool, or strategy, you have the autonomy and backing to build it. An empowering environment: We bring together diverse global perspectives, knowing that solving complex climate challenges requires a wide mix of backgrounds and expertise. Real enterprise impact: Transform how global corporates approach sustainability. CEEZER hosts 50Mt+ of vetted carbon credits across all pathways, all backed by sophisticated data and institutional-grade risk management. A net-zero career: We practice what we preach. From your first day, we fully offset your personal and professional carbon footprint because sustainability is how we operate. The hiring process An intro call with the People Team A Technical Interview with our SVP of Tech, Felipe A Case Study with 2 Engineers from the team Create an impact with us? We know that great talent doesn’t always follow a linear path. If your experience doesn't check every single box on this list, but you have the drive and unique strengths to excel here, we still want to hear from you. Here, building a diverse team isn't a checkbox—It’s how we solve complex global challenges. We make all hiring decisions based on merit, skills, and potential, while actively working to keep unconscious bias out of our process. We’ve created an environment where all individuals feel valued and empowered to succeed. We welcome diverse applicants and are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for everyone to thrive. If you need any adjustments or specific accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. We are here to support you.

title: Marketing Manager
description: What you will work on Ark builds AI platforms for public administrations. We have entered the marked with our most known tool, a platform for local climate action, about 1 year ago, now working with > 60 cities, counties and states - from Schleswig-Holstein and Berlin to small rural municipalities. We have won the German Startup Award 2026, raised 2.4mn in pre seed and grant money and approach 1mn in annual revenues. Tasks About the role We are currently mainly focussing on outbound leads - but see so many inbound opportunities. From webinars with >100 participants, to clients recommending our tool to an invite to advise the chancellor on AI. Since there are no marketing experts in the team, we are not yet capturing these opportunities. And this is why we are looking for a new colleague 🎉 As always in early stage startups, your role will include adjacent tasks, e.g., PR, social media or branding. You will completely own marketing and work on strategic questions as well as operative initiatives. You will conduct events, own google and linkedin ads, set up our newsletter, and much more. You will not be expected to be an expert in every channel. You should be strong in the fundamentals, curious enough to learn quickly and able to decide what deserves focus. You come up with the ideas, launch them fast, measure what works and double down. You report directly to Ruth, our founder and CEO. Your challenge: Own messaging and branding. Decide how we explain what we do and why our target persona should care, and keep that story consistent everywhere. Run campaigns end to end. Scope them, ship them, measure and stop the ones that do not deliver. Open new segments. Build the positioning that lets us grow beyond our current customer base. Measure the funnel. Know where leads come from, what converts, and feed that back to sales and product. Requirements What you bring along Your profile: We are looking for a marketer who is comfortable starting from a blank page: Marketing experience: around 3-5 years of hands-on B2B marketing experience, ideally in a startup, scale-up or similarly entrepreneurial environment. We care more about what you have built and learned than the exact number of years. Full-stack execution: You are equally happy writing a newsletter, briefing a landing page, setting up an ad account and standing at a booth. Analytical rigour: You know how to evaluate the success of your channels and can tell us the difference between a channel that generates noise and one that generates pipeline. Creativity and messaging instinct: You can generate the material and messages we need for the different channels. The material has to land with our German public sector audience. Language: Excellent German and English (C1). Fluent French, Italian or Spanish is a plus. Benefits What you can expect from us 💸 Competitive Compensation Package We value your skills and expertise - enjoy a salary that reflects your impact. 🚀 Ownership & Growth from Day One Take on responsibility from the start, tackle exciting challenges, and accelerate your career with a steep learning curve. 🛖 Offices in both German Startup cities Offices in both, Berlin and Munich. Your home office is Berlin, but you are welcome to work fro the Munich office anytime. 🎉 Team Events & Culture Join a vibrant team with fun social events, and a culture of open feedback and continuous learning. 💛 Exclusive Perks & Benefits Stay active with an EGYM Wellpass / Urban Sports Club membership, plus enjoy discounts on top sustainability brands and Bike Leasing. Admin: Time commitment: Full-time Start date: ASAP Location: Berlin 🤗 We have a few things that matter to us, but we are not looking for a perfect checklist candidate. If you have built things, learned quickly and can show your impact, we would love to hear from you, even if your background does not match every point. Your team lead will be Ruth (Founder and CEO)

title: (Senior) Product Manager (m/f/x)
description: Who We Are At Progyny Global, part of the Progyny, Inc. family, we're on a mission to make fertility, pregnancy, and family-forming care accessible worldwide. By combining world-class clinical expertise with innovative technology, we deliver inclusive, culturally competent support that helps individuals and families navigate some of life's most important journeys. With Progyny's support and global reach, we're expanding access to care and breaking down barriers so that more people can build the families they want, wherever they are in the world. Role Overview We're looking for an experienced, energetic, AI-forward, and performance driven (Senior) Product Manager to join our Product team in Berlin. In this role, you'll take end-to-end ownership of one or more core product capabilities across our member portal and internal operations experience, from discovery and strategy through delivery and iteration. You'll work closely with Design, Engineering, and business stakeholders across Sales, Member Experience, Finance, and Legal to build products that support people through some of life's most sensitive moments. This role is ideal for someone who is self-driven and comfortable owning a domain without heavy oversight, who brings structure and clarity to ambiguity, and who communicates decisions and rationale clearly and concisely to both technical and non-technical audiences. You thrive in start-up speed and maneuverability, while you take steps to improve and optimize how you and the team work to deliver results. You will be working within a small but mighty product team with Product Management, Content and localization, and design, reporting into our Sr. Director of Global Product. Tasks Own multiple product capabilities end to end – from problem definition and discovery through delivery, launch, and ongoing iteration Define product strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for your area, in partnership with product leadership, Engineering, and Design Translate ambiguous business and user problems into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria – can include business analyst-like activities Partner closely with Product Designers on user research, journey mapping, and validating solutions before and during build Work closely with Engineering to prioritize the backlog, unblock delivery, and make sound trade-off calls Coordinate cross-functionally with Sales, Member Experience, Finance, and Legal to align product decisions with operational and business realities Facilitate workshops, stakeholder alignment sessions, and retrospectives Monitor product performance post-launch and drive iteration based on data and user feedback Communicate progress, decisions, and the reasoning behind them clearly and proactively, without needing to be asked Navigate ambiguity and shifting priorities in a fast-moving, dynamic environment balancing oversight on changing variables with granular details Requirements What You Bring At least 6+ years of experience in Product Management, with a track record of owning a product area or capability end to end, from discovery through launch and iteration Demonstrated ability to work independently and proactively – highly organized, self-driven, and comfortable making progress without close direction Clear, structured communicator, able to explain context, decisions, and trade-offs to stakeholders at all levels Strong experience partnering with Design and Engineering throughout the product development lifecycle Comfortable introducing and shaping ‘best practices’ while balancing with the current organizational context AI-forward mindset, ruthless prioritization and consistent, clear verbal and written communication with stakeholders in English Comfortable defining and tracking success metrics, and using data to inform product decisions Comfortable navigating ambiguity and adapting to change in a fast-moving, scaling environment Nice to Have Experience owning workflow-heavy or process-driven capabilities, for example in fintech, insurance, or healthtech (e.g. claims, payments, reimbursement, or similarly regulated operational flows) Familiarity with and affinity for healthcare, wellbeing, or HR technology products Experience working in international teams Benefits Why Join Us 💰 Competitive Base Salary : From €75,000-85,000 per year. 🎯 Bonus Program & Company Equity : Bonuses and ownership opportunities to share in Progyny’s success. 👶 Fertility & Family-Building Benefits : Access to the Progyny Global Platform with a €5,000 benefits budget. 🧘 Mental Health Support : Eight 1:1 psychologist and coaching sessions and wellness tools via Spring Health. 🚲 Sustainable Mobility Benefit : Choice between a Dance e-bike subscription or a BVG public transport ticket. 💪 Urban Sports Club Discount : Access to discounted fitness and wellness activities. 🌴 Paid Leave : 30 days of paid leave per year. 🏡 Hybrid Work : Work from home up to two days per week. ✈️ Remote Work : Up to 8 weeks of remote work per year. 🍽️ Weekly Team Lunches : Team lunch every Thursday. 🐶 Dog Friendly office: Bring your dog to work. We believe that great leaders come from diverse backgrounds. If you’re passionate about building high-performing teams, delivering world-class care, and shaping the future of global member experience, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Sales & Business Development (apeiron)
description: Werde Teil des Business Development Teams zur Förderung der neuen, innovativen apeiron-Plattform! Deine Aufgaben Du entwickelst ein tiefgreifendes Verständnis für unser Produkt apeiron und dessen Marktvorteile, um potenzielle Kund:innen kompetent beraten zu können. Du arbeitest in einem Team aus jungen, initiativen Menschen und bist dem Business Development Manager sowie dem CEO unterstellt. Weiterbildung: Exklusive Seminarangebote zur Selbstreflexion und zu deiner persönlichen sowie fachlichen Weiterentwicklung. title: Trainee (m/w/d) Financial Consulting: Entrepreneurship und IHK-Qualifikation
description: Über uns Willst du in Berlin nur mitspielen oder die Finanzwelt aktiv mitgestalten? Vergiss starre Hierarchien. Bei HORBACH Berlin bieten wir dir den Direkteinstieg in die High-End-Wirtschaftsberatung für Akademiker:innen und Professionals. Wir suchen keine Sachbearbeiter, sondern die nächste Generation von Unternehmer-Persönlichkeiten. Mit über 40 Jahren Markterfahrung im Rücken geben wir dir das Fundament, um dein eigenes Business in der Hauptstadt aufzubauen. Aufgaben Dein Weg zum Financial Consultant Wir investieren in dich, damit du schnellstmöglich auf eigenen Beinen stehst. Dein Weg bei uns ist ein aktiver Karrierestart mit klarer Struktur: Zertifizierte Expertise (IHK): Wir begleiten dich intensiv bei deinen Zertifizierungen (§ 34d & § 34f GewO). Das ist dein staatlich anerkannter Nachweis, der deinen Marktwert in der Branche nachhaltig sichert. Entrepreneurship ab Tag 1: Du lernst, wie man ein eigenes Business führt, von der Strategieentwicklung bis zum komplexen Investment-Closing. Du durchläufst die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette der modernen Beratung. Networking auf High-Level: Du erhältst Zugang zu unseren Netzwerken und lernst die Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe mit Young Professionals und Entscheidern. Karriere-Garantie: Wer das Programm erfolgreich durchläuft, baut sich bei HORBACH eine langfristige Existenz als selbstständiger Partner mit überdurchschnittlichen Entwicklungschancen auf. Qualifikation Das bringst du mit Hintergrund: Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (BWL, Jura, Geisteswissenschaften o. ä.), eine kaufmännische Ausbildung oder stehst kurz vor deinem Abschluss. Mindset: Du besitzt eine „Macher-Mentalität“, arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und ergreifst die Initiative, wenn sich Chancen bieten. Kommunikation: Du trittst souverän auf, bist empathisch und hast die Fähigkeit, Menschen für komplexe Themen zu begeistern. Entwicklungswille: Stillstand ist nichts für dich. Du hast Lust, dich fachlich (IHK) und persönlich kontinuierlich auf ein neues Level zu heben. Quereinstieg: Auch motivierte Quereinsteiger (m/w/d) mit Biss und Lernbereitschaft sind bei uns ausdrücklich willkommen! Benefits Warum HORBACH Berlin? Erfolgsorientierte Vergütung: Dein Engagement zahlt sich aus. Wir bieten ein transparentes Provisionsmodell ohne Deckelung für Einkommensmöglichkeiten weit über Marktdurchschnitt. Unternehmertum mit Back-up: Genieße die Freiheit eines Unternehmers, während du unser Sicherheitsnetz, die IT-Infrastruktur und die Strahlkraft einer etablierten Marke nutzt. Flexibilität: Gestalte deine Arbeitszeit und deinen Ort (inkl. Remote-Optionen) so, wie es zu deinem Leben passt. Bei uns zählt das Ergebnis. Individuelle Roadmap: Ob Top-Consultant oder Führungskraft: Wir planen deinen Aufstieg nach deinen Stärken, nicht nach Dienstjahren. High-End Mentoring: Ein erfahrener Mentor begleitet dich durch ein strukturiertes Onboarding für eine steile Lernkurve. Bereit für den Start? Wir suchen Persönlichkeiten, keine reinen Lebensläufe. Dein Profil oder Link zum LinkedIn-Account reicht uns völlig aus. Wir melden uns innerhalb von 72 Stunden bei dir!

description: Für einen etablierten und vielseitig aufgestellten Betrieb im Bereich Rohrleitungs-, Anlagen- und Apparatebau suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als Aufgaben Fachliche und organisatorische Führung des Werkstattteams von ca. 6 Mitarbeitern Planung, Koordination und Überwachung der laufenden Werkstattarbeiten Fertigung und Bearbeitung von Rohrleitungen, Anlagen- und Apparatekomponenten Sicherstellung einer fachgerechten und qualitativ einwandfreien Ausführung Koordination von Material, Maschinen, Werkzeugen und Personal Überwachung von Terminen, Arbeitsabläufen und Produktionsfortschritt Aktive Mitarbeit bei anspruchsvollen Fertigungs- und Montagearbeiten Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung individueller Kundenanforderungen Koordination zwischen Werkstatt, Projektleitung und Montage Mitverantwortung für Ordnung, Arbeitssicherheit und einen effizienten Werkstattbetrieb Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung von Arbeitsabläufen Qualifikation Abgeschlossene technische oder handwerkliche Berufsausbildung Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Rohrleitungs-, Anlagen- oder Apparatebau Erfahrung in der Führung oder Koordination eines Werkstattteams Gute Kenntnisse in der Metallbearbeitung und im Schweissen Sicheres Lesen und Verstehen von technischen Zeichnungen und Plänen Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise Hohes Qualitäts- und Verantwortungsbewusstsein Organisationstalent und Durchsetzungsvermögen Freude an praktischer Arbeit und an der Führung eines Teams Gute Deutschkenntnisse Benefits Sie übernehmen eine verantwortungsvolle Schlüsselposition mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum.
