title: Revenue Operations Associate
description: Revenue Operations Associate Festanstellung, Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ) Deine Mission Die Energiekosten in Europa sind doppelt so hoch wie in den USA und China. Gleichzeitig wird sich die Stromnachfrage bis 2050 voraussichtlich verdoppeln. Marktpreisvolatilität und zunehmende Komplexität werden uns erhalten bleiben. Damit steht das Rückgrat der europäischen Industrie unter Druck – und Unternehmen müssen jetzt handeln. trawa entwickelt die Lösung: die erste integrierte B2B-Energieplattform, die Energiebeschaffung, Energiemanagement und die Steuerung von Flexibilitäten in einem Produkt vereint. Supply, Manage, Flex – kombiniert. Diese Integration ermöglicht Einsparungen von bis zu 30 % bei den wiederkehrenden Stromkosten und unterstützt Unternehmen gleichzeitig dabei, auf erneuerbare Energien umzusteigen. Wir sind Europas am schnellsten wachsende B2B-Energieplattform. Aktuell sind wir in Deutschland und Österreich aktiv und planen, unsere Aktivitäten 2027 auf einen dritten Markt auszuweiten. Unser Ziel ist die europaweite Skalierung. Wir bewegen uns schnell – das Marktfenster ist offen, und wir wollen es nutzen. Über trawa trawa ist ein Scale-up mit Sitz in Berlin und rund 100 Mitarbeitenden, davon etwa 30 in Product & Tech. Bis heute haben wir mehr als 35 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, darunter eine Series-A-Finanzierungsrunde über 24 Millionen Euro im Mai 2025. Zu unseren Investoren zählen Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic und Tiny VC. Alle drei Gründer sind weiterhin aktiv dabei und zu 100 % committed, das Energieversorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft aufzubauen. Das Team Unser Revenue-Operations-Team ist ein zentraler Wachstumstreiber für den kommerziellen Erfolg von trawa. Es verbindet verschiedene Teams miteinander, schafft effiziente Prozesse und befähigt unseren Vertrieb, sein volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen. Dadurch entsteht ein dynamisches Umfeld, das nachhaltiges Wachstum ermöglicht. Deine Aufgaben Angebotserstellung (Configure-Price-Quote): Du verantwortest den Angebotsprozess und erstellst auf Basis von Kundendaten maßgeschneiderte Energiekonzepte – von passgenauen Stromversorgungsangeboten bis hin zu Batteriespeicherlösungen für die Industrie. Deal-Analyse und Pricing: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Account Executives und der Vertriebsleitung zusammen, um Deals ganzheitlich zu bewerten - dabei erkennst du Ausnahmen und Besonderheiten, weist auf sie hin und koordinierst die notwendigen Freigaben mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartnern. CRM & Deal-Management: Du verantwortest das Deal-Management in unserem CRM – einschließlich der Zuordnung von Deals in Deal-Phasen, der korrekten Erfassung von Produktkategorien und Umsätzen Vertragsmanagement: Du prüfst Verträge für unsere Großkund:innen und stellst sicher, dass unser Vertragswerk passgenau zu ihren Anforderungen passt. Vertriebsstrategie und Planung: Du unterstützt bei Pipeline-Reviews, Forecasts sowie bei der allgemeinen vertrieblichen Steuerung. Was du mitbringst Du denkst analytisch und arbeitest gerne mit Daten. Auffälligkeiten entgehen dir nicht – du gehst ihnen systematisch auf den Grund und identifizierst ihre Ursachen. Du gehst Probleme strukturiert und mit Neugier an. Auch bei einer zunächst unklaren Fragestellung findest du immer eine gute Lösung. Du kommunizierst schriftlich klar und präzise und arbeitest gerne mit internen Stakeholdern sowie Kund:innen und Vertriebspartnern zusammen. Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Auge für Details. Ob ein fehlendes Datum oder eine uneinheitliche Definition einer Kennzahl – du erkennst solche Unstimmigkeiten bevor sie zum Problem werden. Erfahrung mit einem CRM-System wie HubSpot oder Salesforce ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend ist, dass du bereit bist, dich schnell und gründlich in neue Systeme einzuarbeiten. Deine Ziele Nach sechs Wochen: Du hast ein fundiertes Verständnis zu unserem Geschäftsmodell, unserem Produkt und den energiewirtschaftlichen Kontext aufgebaut. Du hast alle wichtigen internen Stakeholder aus Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, Finance und Product kennengelernt und verstehst, wie die einzelnen Teams mit Revenue Operations zusammenarbeiten. Du hast unser CRM-, CPQ- und Reporting-Setup vollständig kennengelernt und kannst dich selbstständig in Deal-Daten und Pipeline-Ansichten orientieren. Du hast einen vollständigen Deal-Zyklus begleitet – von der Opportunity bis zum unterschriebenen Kundenvertrag – und verstehst unseren aktuellen Deal-Desk-Prozess und hast schon erste kleinere Verbesserungspotenziale identifiziert. Nach drei Monaten: Du steuerst unsere Deal-Desk-Prozesse selbstständig. Du hast dich als verlässliche Ansprechperson im Unternehmen bei Fragen rund um Deals und die Angebotsprozesse etabliert. Du identifizierst kontinuierlich Optimierungspotenziale in unseren Prozessen und treibst ihre Weiterentwicklung aktiv voran. Was dir zum Erfolg verhilft Du arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern zusammen, verstehst ihre Anforderungen und unterstützt sie mit pragmatischen, passgenauen Lösungen. Du kommunizierst klar, verbindlich und auf Augenhöhe. Du gehst Aufgaben mit Eigeninitiative und klarer Zielorientierung an. Du denkst analytisch und strukturiert: Komplexe Prozesse zerlegst du gerne in einzelne Schritte, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Zahlen und Metriken. Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Warum trawa? Wirkung: Europäische KMU geben jährlich zwischen 150.000 und 10 Millionen Euro für Strom aus – viele davon zahlen zu viel und sind an veraltete Beschaffungsmodelle gebunden. Mit unserem Produkt veränderst du unmittelbar, wie Tausende Unternehmen Energie einkaufen, managen und nutzen. Die Wirkung ist messbar, der Markt ist riesig und der Zeitpunkt ist jetzt. Verantwortung: Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung für deine Themen und treibst Ergebnisse voran – unabhängig von deinem Hintergrund oder deiner bisherigen Berufserfahrung. Lernen und Entwicklung: Wir stellen dir ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget und feste Zeit für deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung zur Verfügung. Dich erwarten Mentoring, vielfältige Lernmöglichkeiten und echte Perspektiven für deinen nächsten Karriereschritt. Vielfalt und Inklusion: Wir sind ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit lebt, und unser Team spiegelt das wider. Menschen aus mehr als 15 Nationen bringen unterschiedliche Sprachen, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven zusammen. Bei trawa ist Familienfreundlichkeit auf allen Ebenen selbstverständlich – in unserem Team und in der Führung arbeiten Eltern. Wir setzen uns für ein inklusives Umfeld ein, in dem alle ihr Bestes geben können. Vergütung und Benefits: Wir bieten ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket mit Gehalt und Stock Options, 30 Urlaubstagen sowie zahlreichen Benefits. Dazu gehören Zuschüsse für Internet und Mittagessen, eine Mitgliedschaft im Sport Club, feste Lerntage mit jährlichem Weiterbildungsbudget, ein wöchentliches Team-Mittagessen und regelmäßige Teamevents. Bei trawa bauen wir einen vielfältigen, inklusiven und authentischen Arbeitsplatz auf. Wenn dich die Position begeistert, dein bisheriger Weg aber nicht in allen Punkten dem Anforderungsprofil entspricht, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Vielleicht bist du genau die richtige Person für diese oder eine andere Position bei uns.

title: Accounting Lead
description: Accounting Lead Permanent employee · Full-time · Berlin (HQ) Our mission for you Build the Finance function that carries the German Mittelstand through the energy transition, powered by green energy, sharp processes, and modern tooling. trawa enables mid-sized companies to access green, intelligent energy. We're growing fast in a hypergrowth environment, operating in one of the most complex regulatory markets in Germany. Energy accounting is genuinely complex and exciting, from PPA and spot to futures and direct marketing. We're looking for an Accounting Lead who takes real ownership of Accounting and Finance Operations, with a clear center of gravity in Quote-to-Cash : how customer contracts turn into invoices, receivables, and recognized revenue in an energy scale-up. Alongside taking our Accounting function to the next level under HGB, this is where you'll leave the biggest mark: turning Q2C from firefighting into a designed, scalable process. What you'll own Quote-to-Cash & Revenue Recognition Take Q2C to the next level: own invoicing, AR, and dunning end to end. Don't just run them – redesign them into scalable, partly automated processes together with Business Ops, Sales, and Tech. Own Revenue Recognition across our energy products, including PPA, spot, futures, and direct marketing. Write the policy, document it, and defend it with our auditor. Shape how billing-relevant customer and contract data is structured across systems. Accounting Own the monthly and annual close under HGB end to end. Your team runs the execution; you set the standard, the cadence, and the quality bar. Own tax coordination with our external advisor, VAT, and internal controls. Redesign core Accounting processes with a clear focus on automation, and build the documentation that makes us audit-ready: process descriptions, close checklists, controls, and audit trails. Define energy-specific accounting principles together with external advisors. Lead our first full external audit as the single point of contact for our auditors. Team leadership Take full functional and disciplinary responsibility for your team, including hiring, performance management, coaching, and development. Coach the team on structure, prioritization, and project delivery – not just technical accounting. Work cross-functionally with Business Ops, Tech, Sales, Treasury/FP&A, our external tax advisor, and auditors. Your first 90 days Month 1 – Understand and shadow: Get deep into our business model, the complexity of the energy market, and our Accounting and Finance Operations landscape. Meet key stakeholders across the team, our tax advisor, Business Ops, and Tech. Shadow the recurring close, run by your team, and map the Q2C process end to end. Month 2 – Take first ownership: Take over Q2C as process owner, identify the highest-impact inefficiency in invoicing or AR, and deliver a first structural improvement. Start owning the close as team lead and document gaps in processes and controls. Month 3 – Own the roadmap: Own Accounting and Finance Operations end to end. Set the roadmap for audit readiness, documentation, internal controls, and the target data model together with Business Ops and Tech. Who you are Must-haves 6+ years of hands-on Accounting experience with a strong HGB foundation and ownership of the monthly and annual close, including audit experience. A proven track record of structurally redesigning Quote-to-Cash – including invoicing, AR, dunning, and revenue recognition – rather than simply running it. You've reshaped a Q2C process at least once and can walk us through what changed, why you changed it, and what the impact was. People leadership experience with full ownership : you've led at least two people and were responsible for hiring, performance, and development. You can point to how they grew under your leadership. A process design and automation mindset. You're openly opinionated about modern, lean tool stacks. Business-fluent English and German at B2+ level – enough to work with HGB, DATEV, tax advisors, and auditors. Nice-to-haves Experience in the energy market, for example PPA, spot, futures, or direct marketing. Experience with ERP selection or rollout. Familiarity with IFRS. Hands-on experience with tools in our stack: DATEV, Moss, Airtable, n8n, and Langdock. Don't worry if you don't match every box. We value ownership, process instinct, and learning speed over perfect CVs. What we offer Real ownership in a high-impact role: Accounting and Finance Operations are yours to shape, and Q2C is where you can leave your signature. A role that grows with the company: trawa is scaling fast, and our Finance organisation is scaling with it. This role comes with genuine headroom: as the function grows around you, so do your scope, your team, and your seniority. We build careers here, not job descriptions. The opportunity to lead our first full external audit: a milestone that takes most people years to reach. The chance to shape an AI-first Finance stack from scratch: not maintain someone else's legacy. Direct contact with our founders and senior leadership. A uniquely complex business model at the intersection of energy, technology, and finance. Flexible working, 30 vacation days, an L&D budget, competitive compensation, VSOPs (share package), meal vouchers, an Urban Sports membership, and a vibrant Berlin office culture.

title: Senior Electrical Engineer - Robotics (m/f/d)

title: (Junior) Campaign Manager (m/w/d) – remote
tags: Kampagnen | Marketing | Employer Branding | Design | KI | HR | Campaign Management
description: Deine Rolle Die Stelle ist zunächst auf ein Jahr befristet. Uns ist eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit wichtig, daher ist eine Übernahme in eine unbefristete Anstellung angestrebt. Als Campaign Manager*in bist du das Herzstück unserer Kundenprojekte: Du verbindest kreatives Marketing, strategische Beratung und operative Exzellenz, um Top-Brands und Arbeitgeber perfekt auf unserer Plattform und Social Media zu inszenieren. Dabei bist du für folgende Themenschwerpunkte verantwortlich: End-to-End Kampagnensteuerung: Du planst, betreust und wickelst Werbekampagnen für unsere Kunden und Agenturen ab. Von der ersten Idee bis zur finalen Umsetzung hast du das Heft fest in der Hand. Multichannel-Setup & Operations: Du setzt Kampagnen zeitgerecht in unseren eigenen Inhouse-Tools sowie auf Social Media um und managst flexibel Umbuchungen oder Stornierungen. Employer Branding & Jobbörse: Du betreust Employer-Branding-Kampagnen unserer Partner, legst zielgruppenstarke Stellenanzeigen an und verwaltest diese passgenau auf unserer StudySmarter Jobbörse, um Arbeitgeber optimal bei der Gen Z zu positionieren. Kreativ-Workflows & Design-Beratung: Du berätst unsere Kunden zur visuellen Gestaltung und Zielgruppenansprache, erstellst Mailings und baust ansprechende Kundenprofile auf. Sales-Schnittstelle & Support: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Sales-Team zusammen, bildest die Schnittstelle zu allen vertriebsrelevanten Bereichen und unterstützt aktiv bei der Weiterentwicklung von Marketing- und Vertriebsaktionen. Data-driven After-Sales: Du analysierst die Kampagnen-Performance, erstellst aussagekräftige Reportings und präsentierst die Ergebnisse überzeugend vor unseren Kunden. Was du für diese Rolle brauchst Background: Idealerweise hast du erste praktische Erfahrung im Online-Marketing, einer (Media-)Agentur, im HR-Marketing/Employer Branding oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld – auch motivierte Quereinsteiger*innen sind bei uns herzlich willkommen! Kommunikationsstärke: Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie echte Freude am direkten, beratenden Kundenkontakt. Organisationstalent: Ein hervorragendes Zeitmanagement, eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, in dynamischen Phasen die richtigen Prioritäten zu setzen. Markengespür & Kundenfokus: Ein geschultes Auge für gutes Design, Kreativität und ein tiefes Verständnis für die unterschiedlichen B2B-Kundenbedürfnisse. Mindset: Hohe Eigenmotivation, der Wille zur persönlichen Weiterentwicklung und die Leidenschaft, ein stark wachsendes EdTech-Unternehmen mit der Vision „Besseres Lernen für alle“ aktiv mitzugestalten. Sprachen: Du sprichst absolut fließend Deutsch und kannst dich auf Englisch gut verständigen. Warum StudySmarter? Wir sind längst mehr als eine Lern-App - StudySmarter begleitet Millionen Menschen von der Schule über das Studium bis in den Berufseinstieg. Dabei bewegen wir uns an der Schnittstelle aus Tech, Social Impact und internationalem Wachstum: Wir setzen früh auf neue Technologien, insbesondere KI, und entwickeln Produkt und Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter. Du bist Teil eines Teams, das diesen Anspruch jeden Tag in die Praxis übersetzt. Was du bei uns findest: Remote-first: Arbeite von dort, wo du am produktivsten bist! Ownership statt Mikromanagement: Kurze Wege zum Founder-Team, echte Entscheidungsbefugnis, kein Wasserkopf. Beteiligung am Erfolg: Du wirst am Unternehmenserfolg von StudySmarter beteiligt (Shares). Gesundheit: Firmenrabatt über EGYM Wellpass für dein Training. Team & Kultur: Regelmäßige Teamevents und Ausflüge, ein diverses und ambitioniertes Team. Modernes Büro in München: Hochwertige Ausstattung, Terrasse – falls du doch mal vor Ort sein möchtest. Verpflegung: Frisches Obst, Säfte, Porridge-Bar und eine Getränke-Flatrate im Büro. Ausstattung & Weiterbildung: Wähl dein eigenes Arbeitsequipment, und wir unterstützen dich aktiv bei Schulungen und Weiterbildungen Deine Bewerbung Schick uns Deinen CV. Ein Anschreiben ist optional. Wir freuen uns über jede Bewerbung und melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei Dir zurück.

title: Product Engineer (m/f/d)
tags: Engineer | Software Developer | KI | AI | Artificial Intelligenz | Künstliche Intelligenz
description: Our Company "Buying Labs is the leading global partner for sourcing and distributing premium consumer goods!" We're looking for a Product Engineer (m/f/d) to join our Tech team at Buying Labs ideally based in Hamburg or remotely for the right fit. In this role, you'll combine deep technical skill with strong product thinking to build tools and features using AI that create real value for our users and our business. You'll own features end to end - from scoping and design through development, deployment, and adoption - and use AI to build smarter and faster at every step. This is a role for builders who care about impact: people who understand both the user perspective and the underlying business processes, who can scope what needs to be built and then make it happen. Your Mission End-to-End Product Delivery: Own features from concept to production and real users, not just code -ship complete solutions that drive measurable business value. Scope requirements, define technical approaches, and deliver across frontend and backend, with quality built in from the start and verified through appropriate testing. Product Thinking & User Focus: Understand user needs and business processes to identify what should be built and why. Translate product ideas and stakeholder input into shipped experiences that users actually adopt. Building AI into Products: Design and integrate AI-powered features into our platform - not just using coding assistants, but building AI solutions that solve real problems for our users. Identify opportunities where AI can speed up workflows, improve decision-making, or unlock new capabilities. Data Modelling & Scalable Systems: Build solid data models and scalable architectures that serve as a reliable foundation for our products. Turn repeated work into shared building blocks (UI components, data import flows, AI pipelines) so each new tool is faster to build than the last. Stakeholder Collaboration & Adoption: Work with stakeholders at all levels - from leadership to operations - to align on priorities and drive adoption of new tools and features. Communicate technical concepts clearly and build buy-in for your solutions across the organisation. Continuous Improvement: Gather feedback early, iterate quickly, and continuously improve what you build. Stay current with emerging technologies and engineering best practices to keep our tools & systems ahead of what the business needs to keep the platform competitive. Nice to Have: Experience with LLM tooling — provider APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini), agent and tool-use patterns (MCP), and evaluating output quality. Familiarity with vector search technologies (pgvector or similar). Hands-on experience with product analytics and observability tools (e.g. PostHog, Sentry) to measure usage and drive adoption. Experience integrating ERPs or operational systems (orders, inventory, master data). Background in eCommerce, wholesale, or B2B platform environments. Python for data tooling; Docker, GitHub Actions, AWS. Your Profile Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 5–8 years of professional experience in software development with a strong product mindset Strong experience with TypeScript and modern React. Backend experience with Node.js, Express or comparable, REST APIs, and PostgreSQL with practical SQL. For mostly building new applications on our modern stack (React 19, Vite, TypeScript, Bun) and occasionally working in an established JavaScript codebase. Familiarity with modern AI/ML frameworks and agentic AI systems and solid skills in data modelling and building scalable system architectures. Comfort operating in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with shifting priorities. Hands-on experience building AI into products (structured extraction, automation, RAG, or agentic workflows), not just using AI coding assistants. Strong engineering quality mindset, with experience building reliable, maintainable products and validating them through appropriate testing. Strong product sense — you understand business processes and the user perspective, not just the code. Strong communication skills and experience working with stakeholders at all levels and driving adoption of the solutions you build. Proactive mindset with strong autonomy and initiative in a dynamic environment Fluent English is required, German is a plus. Why Us? An awesome team & great vibes Work with motivated colleagues in an agile, ambitious, and friendly atmosphere where collaboration and fun go hand in hand with high speed. Flat hierarchies & real growth opportunities Take ownership of your role and develop personally alongside the company. We promote from within and value every voice, regardless of seniority or title. Modern workplace & cutting-edge equipment State-of-the-art office setup including adjustable desks, mobile treadmills, air conditioning, and everything you need to excel in your role. Company pension program (bAV) Smart pension plan with a 30% Buying Labs grant on your contribution—investing in your financial future together. Corporate Benefits membership Access exclusive discounts from a wide range of partner brands and retailers. Full "Deutschlandticket" coverage We cover the complete cost (ca. €60/month) so you can travel sustainably and conveniently throughout Germany. Free bike options Choose between a complimentary "Swapfiets" bike (original or deluxe 7) or opt for JobRad bike-leasing with an additional €26/month grant from Buying Labs. Complimentary food & beverages Free Friday lunch in the office, plus organic fruit & vegetables, drinks, snacks, coffee/tea, healthy shots and seasonal treats (e.g. ice cream, soups) throughout the week. Personalized workspace setup €100 welcome voucher to customize and optimize your workspace from day one. Refer-A-Friend (employee referral program) You love being part of Buying Labs? Fantastic! Then recommend people from your personal network and receive attractive rewards. Sounds like a perfect fit? We can’t wait to meet you – apply now and be part of our journey!

title: Werkstudent Event Marketing (m/w/d)

As a Working Student in Event Management, you will support the preparation, execution and follow-up of events. title: Facilities Architect
description: About Focused Energy Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies. Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally. Your Role Focused Energy is developing its flagship fusion facility at Biblis, Germany — and this role sits at the heart of making it happen. As Facility Development Lead, you will be the senior bridge between our engineering teams, the RWE/Biblis site stakeholders, German design and permitting requirements, utilities providers, and external planning partners. Without this role, Biblis development would slow down, RWE discussions would be less focused, and facility requirements could become fragmented. Engineering leaders would carry too much of the facility strategy and stakeholder interface burden. You will remove that risk by owning the facility development direction end-to-end. Your primary mission: turn Focused Energy’s technical and strategic needs for Biblis into a clear, realistic, and executable facility development plan — and keep it moving. What You'll Do Define the Biblis facility development direction by translating FE’s technical requirements into a phased, executable site, building, and infrastructure plan. • Lead the RWE and site-owner interface on facility planning, infrastructure constraints, utilities, and long-term site expansion, collaborating closely with the Senior Construction Project Manager. • Translate engineering’s needs into facility requirements across lasers, targetry, diagnostics, controls, cleanrooms, electrical systems, safety and operations. • Drive German design and permitting strategy by identifying required approvals, regulatory constraints, fire protection requirements, and risk assessment. • Coordinate external architects, planners, consultants and utilities partners, ensuring their output is aligned with FE’s technical roadmap and decision needs. • Enable senior decision-making by maintaining a clear, current picture of facility options, risks, assumptions, dependencies, and cost/schedule implications, so engineering leadership can act with confidence and without delay. Who You Are Must-haves Experience leading or shaping complex facility, industrial building, infrastructure, or technical site development in Germany. Working knowledge of German building, planning, permitting, and compliance processes. Ability to translate technical engineering needs into facility, layout, infrastructure, and utility requirements. Ability to manage external architects, planners, consultants, or engineering service providers. Strong stakeholder interface experience with site owners, authorities, landlords, utilities, or senior external partners. Professional German and English language capability. Nice-to-haves Experience with energy, nuclear-adjacent, research, cleanroom, laser, laboratory, or high-tech industrial facilities. Direct experience with RWE, grid operators, utilities providers, or major German site owners. Experience with phased campus or brownfield site development. Familiarity with power infrastructure, backup power, grid connection, HVAC, cooling, cleanrooms, or specialist utilities. Architectural, civil, building services, industrial engineering, or related professional qualification. Experience supporting investment cases, board-level decision papers, or strategic facility roadmaps. Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures. Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination. What sets us apart What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected. When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture. What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog . Meet the team behind this journey DeepL is looking for a Senior Information Security Manager to strengthen our Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) function. You'll own the day-to-day operation of our information security and compliance program, with a strong focus on ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II, and a bonus if you bring HIPAA or BSI C5 experience to the table. This isn't a "gatekeeper" role. We're a SaaS scale-up, and our product teams move fast. We need someone who understands risk well enough to take calculated ones, someone who can say "yes, and here's how we do it safely" instead of defaulting to "no." You'll be the person who keeps compliance moving at the speed of the business, not the person who slows it down. You'll be part of our Information Security team, sitting within the broader Security track alongside the IT Security team, both under our Head of Security. You'll work closely with your teammates in Information Security and IT Security to make sure security and compliance work hand in hand rather than in separate lanes. Your responsibilities Program ownership Own and continuously improve our Information Security Management System (ISMS), keeping it aligned with ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, and, where relevant, HIPAA and BSI C5 Maintain and mature our risk register, policy library, vendor/third-party risk assessments, and control monitoring Audits & evidence Act as a hands-on participant in audits, working directly with auditors, control owners, and leadership to prepare, execute, and close out certification and attestation cycles efficiently rather than through brute force Build and refine evidence collection processes using automation and GRC tooling (e.g. Vanta or similar), reducing manual overhead and audit fatigue across the company Design and roll out a model where product and engineering teams own their evidence throughout the control lifecycle, rather than compliance chasing people down before every audit Risk & business partnership Assess risk pragmatically: identify real security and compliance exposure, size it accurately, and make calculated calls that unblock product and engineering teams Partner with engineering, product, IT, People, and Legal to embed security and compliance requirements into existing workflows rather than bolting them on afterward Track regulatory and customer-driven compliance requirements — new customer security questionnaires, evolving frameworks — and translate them into practical, actionable controls Reporting Report on the state of the security and compliance program to stakeholders and leadership, including audit readiness, open risks, and remediation progress Qualities we look for 3-5 years of experience in information security, GRC, or compliance roles, ideally at a SaaS company, and ideally at scaleup pace and scale Hands-on experience running or supporting ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II programs and audits, from control design through evidence collection to certification Experience with HIPAA and/or BSI C5 is a strong plus Practical experience with GRC/evidence automation tooling such as Vanta (or equivalent), including building smooth, low-friction processes around it A track record of building processes that shift evidence ownership to the teams generating the evidence, rather than centralizing it all in compliance Sound risk judgment: comfortable making calculated, defensible risk decisions to keep product teams unblocked, rather than reflexively blocking Strong stakeholder management skills; able to work credibly with engineers, product managers, and leadership without becoming an obstacle Fluent English and German language skills at C1 level (or close by) are required Clear, structured communicator who can translate compliance requirements into language engineering and product teams actually act on What we offer Diverse and internationally distributed team : joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network. Open communication, regular feedback : as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together. Hybrid work, flexible hours : we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration. Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future. Regular in-person team events : we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally. Monthly full-day hacking sessions : every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity. 30 days of annual leave : we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally. Competitive benefits : just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way. If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you! #LI-HK1 We are an equal opportunity employer You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

title: GTM Enablement Intern
description: About Peec AI Peec AI is the analytics platform for AI search. People increasingly discover products and make buying decisions through ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews instead of traditional search, and most brands have no idea where they show up in those answers. Peec gives marketing, SEO, and growth teams the data to see exactly that: how visible their brand is across AI platforms, how they compare to competitors, and where to win. We are defining this category, and the market is moving with us. Peec is a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, past $15M ARR, with an 80+ person team across our Berlin HQ and our New York office. AI-native practice — You use AI coding tools daily and have gone past autocomplete into agentic workflows. You have a considered view on where they genuinely help, where they don't, and what a codebase needs to be a good place to work in with agents. Product judgment — You care about the user experience as much as the technical solution. You can translate ambiguous workflows and business constraints into pragmatic, elegant product experiences. Systems thinking — You are comfortable reasoning across frontend, backend, APIs, infrastructure, observability, security, and compliance when the problem requires it. Operating style — You think in quarters and years, not only sprints. You drive cross-team change through credibility, clear writing, architectural reasoning, and strong stakeholder alignment — not through authority. Collaborative Leadership: A proactive relationship-builder who can set technical direction and influence without formal authority, manage diverse stakeholders and build alignment on difficult technical decisions, while mentoring engineers. Language — Fluent English, written and spoken. You can make complex technical decisions legible to engineers, product partners, design partners, and leadership alike. Our tech stack Frontend: TypeScript, React, Svelte — we are consolidating on React, and this role leads that migration. Backend: TypeScript, Node.js, Nest.js Database: MySQL Infrastructure: Kubernetes on AWS Source Control & CI/CD: GitHub Authentication: FusionAuth, Okta Internal Tools: Retool Messaging: Twilio, SendGrid Forms: Tally Workplace & Benefits Customizable benefits package covering wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays Remote-flexible hybrid setup Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year A great tech and work setup Work with a diverse team of 130+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains Hiring process Initial screening with Talent Acquisition (30 min): get acquainted with bunch, explore your motivation, and understand whether what we offer matches what you are looking for. Hiring Manager call — Engineering (60 min): a conversation with Engineering leadership focused on your scope, frontend leadership, product-engineering mindset, and how you diagnose and lead systemic improvements. Technical Interview (60 min): a hands-on technical conversation focused on frontend engineering craft, TypeScript, component design, maintainability, testing, and pragmatic problem-solving. Technical Interview — System Design (60 min): a frontend/system design conversation focused on architecture, data flow, performance, accessibility, reliability, and trade-offs in complex product systems. VP Product conversation (45 min): a cross-functional conversation focused on product thinking, customer empathy, business acumen, and how you partner with Product and Design on ambiguous problems. Final round (45 min): a closing conversation to align on what we heard across the process, answer remaining questions, and discuss expectations for the role and trial period. title: Head of Engineering (f/m/d)
description: At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions. Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next. We're hiring a Head of Engineering to lead engineering for one of our product tribes. You'll manage 15 to 20 engineers directly, with tech leads in each squad owning technical direction but no management layer between you and the team. You report to the CTO and sit in a tribe leadership trio with the Product Tribe Lead and Design Lead. Which tribe you'd lead is something we'll work out with you during the process. This is a people leadership role with a hard technical requirement. The engineers report to you, so hiring, development, performance and pace are yours. At the same time you have to hold your own on system architecture: challenge estimates from your engineers, spar with the Product Tribe Lead on solutions, and know when a design is wrong before it ships. This role needs both. How we're set up Tribes are the organisational body: people management, capacity, planning and reporting live there. Squads are assigned to problem spaces and run discovery and delivery, each led by a trio of Tech Lead, Product Manager and Product Designer. Tech Leads own the technical decisions in their squad, including estimates, and write code alongside their engineers. They don't manage people. You do. We keep the structure deliberately flat. Management is anchored at tribe level, squad composition flexes to serve the most important work, and structure changes as we learn (roughly every six months in practice, not on a schedule). Discovery and delivery run in parallel: the next mission is scoped before engineers finish the current one, so engineers weigh in on architecture early and have the context to unblock themselves. What you'll own Feasibility and delivery for the tribe. You're accountable for tribe-wide delivery outcomes and velocity: the right problems, solved at the right quality, as fast as possible. The people. 15 to 20 direct reports. Hiring, onboarding, expectations, feedback, development, compensation and promotion recommendations, and the tough calls that keep talent density high. Tech Leads feed you performance signals; the decisions and the conversations are yours. Technical judgement across squads. Broad understanding of the tribe's systems and how they fit into the wider Moss architecture. You challenge estimates and technical proposals from your engineers; you don't produce the estimates yourself. A seat in the tribe trio. Roadmap and planning input through a feasibility lens. You argue solutions and trade-offs with the Product Tribe Lead as a technical peer, and push back on scope and timelines when the engineering picture says so. Operating rhythm. How the tribe plans, estimates, tracks and reports on delivery, with proactive, timely transparency to the tribe and to leadership, the good and the bad. Capacity. Putting your best people on the most impactful work, moving engineers between squads (and, where it serves Moss, between tribes) while still letting people build real domain depth. Alignment across tribes. Tribe leads aren't isolated trios. You align proactively with your peer Heads of Engineering and with platform and architecture owners, and you resolve shared-architecture questions through alignment, not around it. How we expect leaders to operate Velocity first, with high agency. Working smart and hard on the right problems. Lead by example, stay close to the work. You know the details of what your team is building and course-correct in real time. You get hands-on when speed or quality is on the line. End-to-end ownership of outcomes. Responsibility doesn't stop at your team's boundary. Make changes elsewhere when that's what it takes, communicating first, not unilaterally. No waterfall, no blame. Product, Design and Engineering work together from the start. If there's a gap in the trio, fill it or name it. Disagree and commit. Challenge when it matters. Once a call is made, own the message and explain the why, including for calls you argued against. Proactive expertise. We build expert products for finance teams. Decisions rest on real expertise, internal and external, not assumptions. Moss has one manager framework for every people leader, and this role is held to it in full: build a high-performing team, define success clearly, deliver results with your team, and operate with speed and ownership. You can hold us to it too. What you bring 4 to 6+ years in engineering management , with a track record of managing engineers directly at a meaningful span. You've run hiring, performance management and difficult conversations yourself, not through a layer of managers. A senior engineering career before that. You've operated at senior or staff level as an engineer and your judgement on system design is current, not historical. Strong systems design. You can read an architecture, spot where it will break, and argue an alternative with the people who built it. You can tell a 2-week estimate from a 6-week one and explain why. Comfort as a technical peer to product leadership. You've shaped roadmaps and scope through feasibility arguments, and you've won and lost those arguments gracefully. Structure at scale without a middle layer. You build the practices that make 15 to 20 direct reports work: clear expectations, regular feedback, visible delivery. Fast in unfamiliar domains. You can reason about a new technical domain quickly and contribute before you have deep prior expertise in it. Experience from an environment with mature engineering practices : code review, testing, incident handling, planning and estimation that actually work. You know what good looks like and can build it where it's missing. Strong pluses Background at an AI product company or in ERP / financial systems. Both are directly relevant to what we build. Experience leading in a flat or tribe/squad-style organisation. Experience with a Tech Lead / Engineering Manager split, as either side of it. What this role is, and isn't It's worth being clear about the shape of the job. Your technical contribution is judgement, challenge and architecture-level input; Tech Leads own the how and write the code alongside their squads, so this isn't a role with an IC workload attached. And it's a role where you manage engineers, not managers: every engineer in the tribe reports to you directly, there is no management layer beneath you, and we don't plan to add one. If that combination of deep people leadership and real technical engagement is what you're looking for, you'll find a lot to like here. About Moss Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work. Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star. We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA : playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect: Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos. Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits. Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).
